articleTitle: Exploration and Innovation of the Integrated Training Model of Industry, Academia and Research for Elderly Health Service Talents
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The growing elderly population and the trend of population aging have highlighted the demand for elderly health services. To cultivate the professionals that the above demand requires, the integrated education model of industry, academia, and research for the elderly health service professionals has been developed. This study takes the integrated education model of industry, academia, and research for elderly health service professionals as the research object. The literature review and case study methods lead by relevant research literature and practical cases can be used for collection and analysis. The results show that the integrated education model of industry, academia, and research for the elderly health service professionals has a strong innovation and advancement effect, has a positive impact on the training of higher level elderly health service and management professionals, the improvement of service quality and coverage, and promotion of health and well-being of the elderly. However, as to whether the education model can be more flexible and adjustable, whether it can continue to meet the needs of the elderly health service and other social services, there is a need for further research and evaluation.

articleTitle: Automobile Customer Behavior Analysis and Service Optimization Based on Big Data and AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper discusses the frontier application of big data and artificial intelligence (AI) technology in automobile customer behavior analysis and service optimization. By systematically integrating diversified customer data, using big data analysis technology to accurately discover customer behavior patterns and potential trends, and combining AI technology to build an intelligent customer service system, it provides innovative service concepts and practical paths for automobile enterprises. It aims to significantly improve the service quality and efficiency of automobile enterprises, and then promote the innovation pace and development momentum of the entire automobile industry.

articleTitle: Intelligent Teaching: An Exploration of Teacher Self-Directed Learning Models Driven by Large Models to Improve Digital Literacy
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper explores a new model of teacher self-directed learning, analyzing the advantages of large models in adult self-directed learning and discussing their feasibility in professional teacher development. Combining adult learning theories, particularly Zimmerman's self-regulated learning model, it analyzes the potential benefits of large models in teacher self-directed learning across three stages: forethought, performance, and self-reflection. These models can assist teachers in setting learning goals, providing personalized resources, and recommending learning strategies, guiding them through the learning process by answering questions and offering suggestions, and helping teachers evaluate learning outcomes, engage in self-reflection, and plan subsequent learning actions to enhance their digital literacy.

articleTitle: Acupuncture for acute attack stage of bronchial asthma: A protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Introduction: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of acupuncture on acute attack stage of bronchial asthma. Methods and analysis: We will search from the following databases, PubMed, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, EMBASE, Web of Science, Chinese BioMedical Literature Database (CBM), China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Wan Fang Data and VIP Database for Chinese Technical Periodicals (CQVIP). We selected the eligible studies published up to July 2024.All randomised controlled trials related to acupuncture for acute attack stage of bronchial asthma will be included. The main outcomes include the total effective rate, Pulmonary function indicators: PEF, FEV1/FVC, FEV1.The secondary outcomes include asthma Quality of Life Scale (AQLQ), peripheral blood eosinophil count and adverse events or reactions. RevMan 5.3 statistical software will be used for meta-analysis, and the level of evidence will be assessed by Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation. Conclusion: The systematic review will provide a basis for evaluating the efficacy and safety of acupuncture in the treatment of acute attack stage of bronchial asthma.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Approaches to Teacher Ethics Education for Normal University Students: Taking Mathematics Normal University Students as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Teacher morality, as an important aspect of teachers' quality, is one of the prerequisite conditions for new teachers to stand firmly on the teaching platform. Taking the issue of teacher morality cultivation for mathematics normal students as an example, this paper explores new approaches to teacher morality education for normal students from four aspects: training programs, professional courses, practical links, and evaluation systems. It is helpful to cultivate batches of outstanding teachers with noble teacher morality, strong professional ability, and deep educational sentiments, and contribute to the educational cause of our country.

articleTitle: The Study on Professional Quality of Counselors in Higher Vocational Colleges in China Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To understand the current situation of the research on the professional quality of counselors in higher vocational colleges in China, the CiteSpace analysis method was used to make classified statistics and comparative analysis on the publication time, research hotspots, research methods, authors and institutions, literature citations and so on. The results show: The existing research on the quality of counselors in higher vocational colleges has the problems of single research method, insufficient depth and insufficient quality. Based on the characteristics of students in higher vocational colleges, such as low cultural level, low action consciousness and pursuit of fresh trends, Empirical research methods should be employed to conduct in-depth and practical studies on the improvement of counselors' professional abilities, especially in terms of their ideological leadership and innovative development capabilities, in order to enhance the quality of research. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Research on the Limited-Rational Engage of "Teacher-Machine-Student" Teaching Paradigm based on Evolutionary Game Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The essence of the human-machine collaborative "teacher-machine-student" educational paradigm lies in the collaborative interplay among all participants, aimed at elevating instructional quality and enhancing student performance. This study constructs a trilateral evolutionary game model aimed at maximizing educational effectiveness based on the beneficial relationships among teachers, machines, and students within the educational paradigm. It explores the strategic choices of each party during the game process, investigates the evolutionary paths of their behavioral strategies, and identifies the conditions for gradual stability. Matlab is utilized to analyze how changes in influencing factors within the evolutionary game model impact strategy selection. The research identifies that the optimal strategy equilibrium for enhancing educational efficacy involves teachers choosing proactive engagement, machines opting for proactive involvement, and students committing to active participation. For each entity, adjustments in teacher reputation gains, machine self-evolution benefits, and student learning gains influence their strategic decisions. These findings underscore the inherent principles of collaboration among teachers, machines, and students, offering concrete implementation strategies to promote human-machine cooperation and mutual educational advancement.

articleTitle: Design of "Demand-Driven, Competition-Driven Learning" Practice Teaching Program
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Addressing the practical teaching challenges in curriculum design and similar areas encountered in the cultivation of undergraduate talents in emerging engineering education, particularly computer science, this paper proposes a demand-driven and outcome-oriented practical teaching design program. By designing diversified curriculum design topics based on actual enterprise demands, the proposed program guides students to deeply analyze requirements, rationally plan and implement projects, and subsequently apply their completed works to relevant academic competitions. Through the demand-driven, competition-driven learning model with an outcome-oriented approach, the proposed program aims to cultivate students' innovative capabilities and practical skills, ultimately seeking to comprehensively enhance the cultivation quality of undergraduate talents in emerging engineering education, specifically computer science.

articleTitle: Interactive Course Teaching Practices in Big Data Introduction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The era of big data brought significant changes in the development of information technology, deep impacting various aspects of societal production and daily life. This study aimed to enhance the understanding of big data among students by creating a three-dimensional interactive teaching environment based on current smart teaching methods. Through this course teaching reform, students gained a comprehensive overview of big data, understood its professional development direction, grasped key concepts, and cultivated big data thinking skills in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere, preparing them for future courses and studies.

articleTitle: Online Streaming Feature Selection for Class-Imbalanced Data Oriented Hierarchical Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In numerous practical domains, the feature space of data exhibits distinct characteristics, such as high dimensionality and dynamism, while the label space demonstrates a hierarchical structure and typically follows a long-tail distribution. To address this type of data, we propose an online streaming feature selection method based on hierarchical neighborhood consistency, which can select discriminative features from the streaming feature space. First, the number of neighbors for the target sample is determined by the number of samples in its class, and whether these neighbors are positive or negative is identified using the sibling strategy. Based on this novel hierarchical neighborhood relationship, hierarchical neighborhood consistency is defined at three levels: the individual sample, the layer, and the entire tree. Second, based on hierarchical neighborhood consistency, we establish three criteria for evaluating online streaming features: online importance analysis, online correlation analysis, and online redundancy analysis. Additionally, a framework for selecting online streaming features is designed. Finally, extensive experiments conducted on six hierarchical datasets demonstrate that the proposed algorithm significantly improves prediction accuracy for minority classes compared to several popular online streaming feature selection algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and development of virtual reality technology in teaching science courses -the example of "Energy and minerals - coal"
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, as the level of science and technology continues to develop rapidly, higher demands have been placed on the scientific literacy of citizens. The traditional science classroom may lead to students' insufficient understanding of scientific knowledge and difficulty in forming systematic scientific thinking. Teaching resources developed through virtual reality technology can enrich the educational environment and visualize complex structures. In the chapter "Energy and Minerals - Coal" in the fifth grade of elementary school, the knowledge of coal involves complex physicochemical change processes. The article adopts the literature research method to explore the current status of domestic and international research, related policies and concepts. Through the questionnaire survey method and interview method, it clarifies the needs of teachers and students for the course, demonstrates the feasibility of the study, and carries out the VR teaching design from the four aspects of scientific concepts, scientific thinking, inquiry and practice, attitude and responsibility, corresponding to the six boards are the formation of coal, the distribution of China's mineral resources, the display of the mineral model, the coal combustion experiments, and coal power generation experiments, and describes in detail the process of the development of the teaching resource .

articleTitle: Clinical study on modified Huagai powder in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia with wind cold closed lung syndrome
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:Exploring the effectiveness of modified Huagai San in treating pediatric bronchopneumonia with wind cold closed lung syndrome. Method: 80 children with bronchopneumonia admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from January 2023 to December 2023 were randomly divided into two groups, with 40 cases in each group. The control group was treated with conventional Western medicine, while the observation group was treated with modified Huagai San on the basis of the control group. After one week of intervention, compare the clinical treatment efficacy, white blood cell count (WBC), and serum high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) between the two groups. Result: The total effective rate of the observation group was higher than that of the control group after treatment, and P<0.05. After intervention, the levels of WBC and hs-CRP in both groups were significantly reduced (P<0.05), and the observation group was significantly lower than the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: The use of modified Huagai powder in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia patients with wind cold closed lung syndrome can significantly improve clinical efficacy and reduce the body's inflammatory response.

articleTitle: Advanced Mathematics Teaching Design Based on the MicroSpark Online Learning Platform and the Decomposed BOPPPS Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the MicroSpark online learning platform, a DBOPPPS (Decomposed BOPPPS) teaching model was designed. This new model effectively illustrates the relationships between knowledge points in the Advanced Mathematics course, facilitating smooth transitions in classroom instruction and aiding students in grasping the overall knowledge structure of the course. By integrating with the online practice platform, leveraging the advantages of informatization, the model enables teachers to promptly identify the difficulties encountered by students in their learning process, thereby effectively assisting students in better mastering the course knowledge. The classroom teaching content designed according to this model is interconnected, and it stimulates students’ interest in learning new knowledge, enhancing the quality of course learning. Finally, specific teaching cases for "Advanced Mathematics" were designed, and through the analysis of student learning outcomes, the rationality and superiority of this new model are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Mixup Data Augmentation and Channel-Spatial Attention Mechanisms for Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of computer vision, facial expression recognition has made significant progress in areas like human-computer interaction, mental health, driver assistance, and education. However, traditional facial expression recognition techniques exhibit poor robustness under complex backgrounds and varying lighting conditions, making them susceptible to environmental noise and challenging to accurately capture and classify complex emotional states. Additionally, these techniques often lack in data augmentation and model generalization capabilities, leading to overfitting on training samples and insufficient recognition of unseen samples. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel convolutional neural network model—HSCNet (A Hybrid Data Augmentation and Channel-Spatial Attention Mechanisms Neural Network). The HSCNet model first employs the Mixup data augmentation technique to generate new training samples, then utilizes the Res2Net50 backbone network combined with the CBAM attention mechanism and average-max pooling techniques to extract significant features while suppressing redundant ones. This approach not only enhances feature extraction accuracy but also significantly improves the model’s generalization ability and robustness in facial expression recognition tasks. Finally, tested on the public dataset FERPlus, which includes eight types of emotions, the HSCNet model achieved an accuracy rate of 89.72%, demonstrating excellent performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Image Matching Algorithm Under Adverse Conditions Based on SIFT
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Image matching technology is crucial in computer vision applications. However, the traditional SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) algorithm often faces challenges under adverse conditions, such as a high number of mismatched points and few accurately matched points. Additionally, in practical scenarios, environmental factors like lighting changes and image blurring further reduce image similarity. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved SIFT-based image matching algorithm to address these challenges. First, SIFT is used to extract image features, and a bidirectional FLANN (Fast Library for Approximate Nearest Neighbors) matching strategy is employed to initially filter out incorrect features. Then, the RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) algorithm is used to screen out unreliable matching point pairs. Finally, the matching accuracy is evaluated based on the remaining pure matching point pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared to the traditional SIFT algorithm, this improved algorithm achieves higher matching accuracy and robustness under adverse conditions, exhibiting superior performance.

articleTitle: Scenario Construction of Smart Education in Universities: Teaching Practice Based on Management Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Undoubtedly, smart education has become a hot spot of teaching reform in colleges and universities. This paper adopts situational learning theory, combines virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR) and other technologies, and constructs a teaching platform that simulates real management scenarios. Through personalized learning path, social function and real-time feedback mechanism, it realizes the effective docking between teaching content and students' needs. The research design includes multiple stages of needs analysis, technology selection, course design, instructor training, student guidance, implementation monitoring, evaluation and feedback, and adjustment and optimization. This paper compares the quiz scores and assignment completion rates of 30 students in a management course in a smart and traditional teaching environment. The results show that the highest student achievement in the smart teaching environment reached 100 points, while the highest in the traditional teaching environment was only 93 points; the completion rate of student assignments in smart education was generally higher than that in traditional education, with the highest reaching 100%. These data indicate that the scenario-built smart education model significantly improves students' learning effectiveness and engagement. Although problems with technology integration and student adaptability were encountered during implementation, they can be effectively overcome through ongoing teacher professional development and the provision of personalized learning pathways.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-organ Edge Segmentation Technology in Abdominal MRI Based on Unet++
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of medical imaging technology, abdominal MRI has become an important tool for the evaluation and diagnosis of a variety of diseases. However, accurate organ edge segmentation is essential to improve diagnostic accuracy. This study aims to develop an automatic segmentation method based on deep learning to improve the accuracy and efficiency of multi-organ edge segmentation in abdominal MRI. First, we collected a set of abdominal MRI image datasets containing different pathological states and preprocessed them, including denoising, contrast enhancement, and normalization. Then, we designed a deep learning network architecture that combines the characteristics of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and U-Net++ models to make full use of contextual information in the image and improve the accuracy of edge detection.

articleTitle: Exploring the application of family centered comprehensive nursing in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Observe the application effect of family centered comprehensive nursing in pediatric bronchopneumonia. Method: Sixty pediatric patients with bronchopneumonia admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from January 2023 to December 2023 were randomly divided into two groups, with 30 cases in each group. The control group received routine care, while the study group received comprehensive care centered around the family. After 7 days of intervention, compare the treatment effect, nursing satisfaction, and clinical symptom improvement between the two groups. Result: The total effective rate and nursing satisfaction of the study group were significantly higher than those of the control group, and the study group was significantly higher than the control group (P<0.05); The study group showed significantly shorter fever relief time, cough disappearance time, lung rales disappearance, and hospital stay, with statistically significant differences (P<0.05). Conclusion: Comprehensive home centered care for pediatric bronchopneumonia patients can further accelerate symptom resolution and help improve clinical efficacy.

articleTitle: Research and analysis on structural safety hazards of self-built houses-Taking self-built houses in two towns in Luojiang District, Quanzhou City as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to carry out the special management work of housing structure safety, this article investigates the hidden dangers of the of self-built houses in Heshi Town and Majia Town, Luojiang District of Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, and analyzes the current situation of self-built houses in rural areas and the reasons for its various safety hazards.The purpose, structure type, main safety problems and their causes of 1111 self-built houses in the region are summarized. The investigation adopted four classification standards and three investigation methods, and obtained the investigation results of two towns. At the end of the article, some suggestions were put forward for the hidden trouble investigation and safety management of rural self-built houses.

articleTitle: Efficient activity promoting learning style based on pattern recognition algorithm Construction strategy study: Take a second-tier university in Shandong Province as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study takes a second-tier university in Shandong Province as an example, combined with pattern recognition algorithm, and started with the types of activities carried out in the construction of students' style of study as the benchmark, set the default module sequence, and analyzed students' participation and initiative in the construction of style of study from the perspectives of participants, nature, current situation and satisfaction. Three clustering centers, namely, the nature of participation, the number of participation and the level of satisfaction, were used for effective data analysis. In this study, a development evaluation index system of "Efficient activity promoting learning style construction" was constructed. By establishing entropy weight-TOPSIS model, coupling coordination degree model and obstacle degree model, the activity participation data in 5-10 years were measured and analyzed. Based on the clustering results and measurement analysis, propose suggestions for the diversification and practical content of activities that effectively promote the construction of academic atmosphere, help to create a model of academic atmosphere construction strategies in universities, accelerate the quality of academic atmosphere construction processes in various universities, and provide suggestions for promoting student growth and development plans.

articleTitle: Adaptation, Revision, and Reliability and Validity Assessment of the Chinese Version of the Video Therapy Attitude Scale (VTAS)
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: This study aimed to adapt and revise Kate Smaller's Video Therapy Attitude Scale (VTAS) for Chinese counselors and evaluate its reliability and validity. Methods: The VTAS was translated, back-translated, and culturally adapted to create a Chinese version. A total of 422 questionnaires were collected from two surveys of Chinese counselors using convenience sampling. Reliability and validity were assessed through item analysis, exploratory factor analysis (EFA), and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). Results: The revised VTAS consists of 14 items across two dimensions. Item analysis indicated significant critical ratios (P < 0.05) for all items, with item-total correlations exceeding 0.4. EFA revealed a KMO value of 0.855 and identified two factors explaining 51.3% of the variance. CFA results indicated X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/df = 1.961, RMSEA = 0.035, RMR = 0.035, GFI = 0.936, AGFI = 0.911, CFI = 0.936, IFI = 0.960, and TLI = 0.952. Both dimensions had CR values above 0.8, and inter-dimension correlations were lower than the square root of the AVE, indicating strong structural, convergent, and discriminant validity. The scale demonstrated strong internal consistency with a Cronbach's α of 0.866 and a split-half reliability of 0.829. The two dimensions had Cronbach's α of 0.829 and 0.812, respectively. Conclusion: The Chinese version of the VTAS is a reliable and valid instrument for assessing Chinese counselors' attitudes toward video therapy.

articleTitle: Quadratic Estimation for Discrete Time System with Packet Dropping and Unknown Input
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of quadratic estimation for discrete time systems with packet dropping and unknown input. The Kronecker algebra approach is employed to obtain the second order Kronecker powers of original state and measurement. After that, the quadratic system is constructed by means of the initial system and its second Kronecker power. Furthermore, a particular condition is imposed to suppress the interference caused by unknown input. Based on the constraint, we design a minimum variance unbiased quadratic estimator, which is not only suitable to Gaussian noise, but also applicable to non-Gaussian noise. Finally, a simulation example is provided to illustrate the good performance of the quadratic estimator designed.

articleTitle: Application of Generative AI in the Teaching of Human Resource Management Course for Medical and Health Management Majors
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of AI (Artificial Intelligence) technology, it has been increasingly utilized in the field of education. This paper takes the course of Human Resource Management for medical and health management majors as an example and discusses in some detail the potential and practical effectiveness of generative AI in enhancing the efficiency and quality of teaching in this course. This paper uses the case study method to explore the intelligent generation of knowledge points, personalized learning recommendation system, and intelligent homework correction of generative AI in classroom teaching. In addition, this paper evaluates the teaching effect of generative AI from various aspects, such as students’ learning effectiveness, participation, and satisfaction. Through the collection and analysis of relevant data, it is facilitated that generative AI can effectively improve students’ learning motivation and achievement and strengthen the implementation of classroom interaction and individual teaching. The study shows that generative AI can not only improve the quality and efficiency of teaching, but also continuously optimize teaching strategies through data-driven approaches, creating more value for both teachers and students. The case study found that students 001 and 003 were more engaged, as evidenced by the relatively high number of logins, forum postings, and project submissions, and accordingly, their satisfaction scores were higher, at 4 and 5, respectively. In conclusion, the application of generative AI technology in the teaching of Human Resource Management course for medical and health management majors demonstrates its broad prospect in the field of educational technology.

articleTitle: Research on Precision Machining of CNC Machine Tools Based on Industrial Big Data Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Quality and efficiency are eternal themes of intelligent manufacturing, and the key equipment that affects quality and efficiency in metal cutting intelligent manufacturing production lines is CNC machine tools. CNC machine tools belong to precision manufacturing equipment. Although their technical indicators can reach a high level when leaving the factory, their machining accuracy is affected by factors such as fixtures, cutting tools, environmental temperature, vibration, component aging, and workpiece material consistency when applied to actual production lines. Therefore, this article introduces industrial big data algorithms to fully explore and showcase the value contained in industrial big data, effectively forming data-driven, fast iterative, and continuously optimized industrial intelligent systems, thereby effectively solving the problem of machining accuracy stability in intelligent manufacturing systems. The experimental results showed that all 30 workpieces were qualified after processing.

articleTitle: Innovative Construction and Application of Knowledge Graphs in Project-Based School-Enterprise Cooperative Courses : Taking the Course "BIM Data and Carbon Emission" as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: technology, the innovative construction of project-based learning and school-enterprise cooperative courses has become an important research direction in the field of education. This review, based on the "BIM Data and Carbon Emission" school-enterprise cooperative course, explores the application of knowledge graphs in project-based teaching and the changes it brings. By combining knowledge graphs with project-based teaching, course design can achieve more precise knowledge management and information integration, thereby enhancing students' practical and project management skills. The application of knowledge graphs not only optimizes the organization and retrieval of project resources but also supports customized learning paths and goal setting, enhancing the practical application value of school-enterprise cooperative courses. This innovative model effectively connects theory and practice in project-based teaching, providing new ideas and methods for future curriculum reform.

articleTitle: Research on Gamification of Diabetes Education
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Diabetes education plays a significant role in medical education. Still, traditional teaching approaches have several drawbacks, including a reliance on a single approach and a gap between theory and practice. In order to improve student's learning experience and motivation, this paper provides an online gamified teaching solution for diabetes that makes use of gamification aspects and contemporary information technology. The program incorporates scenario simulation, character creation, a case system, and leaderboards to replicate a real clinic environment and to motivate students through certificates, points, and leaderboards. The program's implementation results demonstrated a substantial increase in the number of hours students spent online learning, their ability to comprehend knowledge points, and their test scores. Students generally found this learning method to be both engaging and effective, as indicated by questionnaire surveys. This study presents a novel teaching paradigm for diabetes education that is valuable for replication.

articleTitle: A Review of Convolutional Neural Networks in the Field of Agricultural Pest and Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The problem of crop diseases and pests severely hinders the production and development of modern agriculture. Convolutional neural networks possess powerful feature extraction capabilities. During the growth process of crops, using convolutional neural network technology helps accurately and efficiently analyze agricultural diseases and pests. This allows farmers to take timely and appropriate remedial measures, thereby improving crop yields. This review analyzes the current state of research on the application of convolutional neural network models in the automatic identification of crop diseases and pests. It discusses the development status and key technologies of various algorithms both domestically and internationally, points out their shortcomings, and further elaborates on the future development trends of high-performance crop disease and pest identification algorithms. This provides a reference for subsequent related research.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Vision-Based Environment Perception and Decision-Making System for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper delves into the design and implementation of autonomous vehicle systems, with a focus on the overall architecture, hardware platforms, software design, and system integration. The autonomous driving system captures environmental information through high-precision sensors, which is then processed in real-time and decisions are made by powerful computing units, leading to vehicle control actions. Throughout the design and implementation process, emphasis is placed on real-time performance, robustness, and safety considerations. System performance is continuously enhanced through algorithm optimizations, hardware advancements, and improvements in system integration strategies. The objective of this research is to provide a robust foundation for the advancement of autonomous vehicles, thereby propelling progress in smart transportation systems.

articleTitle: Food Waste Composting Behaviors of Community Residents Promote Subjective Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Although well-being is a fundamental human goal, few studies have clarified the underlying mechanisms by which food waste composting behaviors affect well-being. To fill this gap, we investigated 410 community residents to explore the relationship between food waste composting behaviors and well-being. It turned out that community residents who engaged in food waste composting behaviors had a higher subjective well-being than those who did not. Nature connectedness mediated the effect of food waste composting behaviors on well-being. These result findings not only provide compelling evidence for how food waste composting behaviors can promote well-being but also generate important implications for policy-makers.

articleTitle: Experimental teaching of information system security based on BBF model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To effectively achieve the experimental teaching objectives of information system security course, this paper analyzes the problems existing in traditional experimental teaching of information system security course, proposes an offensive and defensive experimental teaching mode based on BBF model, and discusses how to comprehensively enhance students' innovation and practical abilities through the design of the three core elements of BBF mode: system construction, attack penetration, and security repair. Taking SQL injection as an example, this paper introduces the implementation scheme of BBF-based offensive and defensive experimental teaching, and evaluates the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Research on YOLOv5 Lightweight Algorithm for Camellia Oleifera Fruit Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Due to the large number of parameters and high computational complexity, it is difficult to deploy a generalized detection and recognition model directly on mobile. In order to solve the difficulty of lightweight mobile deployment and enhance the recognition ability of Camellia oleifera fruit on mobile devices, a lightweight and real-time detection model is proposed. First, a depth-separable convolution is introduced to scale down the traditional YOLO v5s network, and the unimportant channels are pruned using model sparsity training and batch normalized scaling factor distribution condition. Finally, the bounding box regression loss function is improved to EIoU loss function to obtain more accurate box localization to enhance the model recognition ability. The experimental results show that the improved model can be effectively lightweight while maintaining the model performance. Compared with the traditional YOLO v5s, the mAP of the improved algorithm is increased by 0.2 percentage points, while the weight of the improved model is 35.68, which is 8.35MB less than the original model, and the FPS is 35.68, which is able to satisfy the requirements of the deployment of mobile and embedded devices, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of vocational education dynamics evolution based on topic modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Clarifying the focus of vocational education dynamics is crucial for understanding the current situation and future development trends. However, comprehensive exploration on vocational education dynamics is inadequate presently. In this paper, textual information on vocational education is analyzed with Latent Dirichlet Allocation, BERTopic, and the Dynamic Topic Model. Two key issues are thoroughly investigated as follows: (1) What are the main aspects of the current development of vocational education; (2) How to learn the embeddings of vocational education text and further to promote the formulation of policy. The experiments are conducted and the experimental results show that LDA and BERTopic model achieve effective performance in clustering the texts of vocational education dynamics, and the DTM captures the topics trend of vocational education, which facilitate the government to guide the formulation and implementation of policies.

articleTitle: ExPose: A Web-based Platform for AI-assisted Generation of Exercise Illustrations for Rehabilitation Prescriptions
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The exercise illustration of rehabilitation prescriptions is to provide a more intuitive and understandable way to convey medical guidance through visual means. Currently, the generation of exercise illustrations for rehabilitation prescriptions relies mainly on manual drawing, either using software or by hand. However, this method suffers from not only complexity and high labor costs, but also low production efficiency. While today's Generative AI (GenAI) has achieved great success in text and image generation, images that meet descriptions can be generated quickly from prompts or images using diffusion models and the ControlNet model. However, WebUI and ComfyUI, the most popular user interfaces for diffusion models at present, are too general for the specific task of generating exercise illustrations from rehabilitation prescriptions, partly due to the application and domain-specific complexity. This research proposes ExPose, a dedicated web-based platform, for the generation of exercise illustrations from rehabilitation prescriptions. With embedded image editing functions, ExPose enables users to crop, modify, and annotate the generated intermediate images, thus providing streamlined image processing and facilitating iterative image retouching and enhancement. The use cases demonstrate that ExPose generates high-quality exercise illustrations that better meet expectations from rehabilitation prescriptions. Evaluation results show that ExPose achieves a high rate of user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Integrated Curriculum Reconstruction and Resource Development : A Case Study of Application of Python in Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of educational informatization, digitally integrated and interactive teaching resources have become a vital component of educational informatization. Integrated curriculum reconstruction and resource development refer to the formation of a diversified and all-encompassing educational system by integrating various knowledge, skills, and experiences. This model emphasizes enhancing students' comprehensive understanding and mastery of "Application of Python in Finance" through multiple knowledge domains, incorporating advanced educational concepts and methods in educational evaluation and curriculum ideology, thereby fostering students' comprehensive qualities and abilities, improving educational quality, and achieving better teaching outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Digital Competence of Vocational and Technical Education students
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study deeply discusses the connotation, practical value and training strategy of digital competence of vocational and technical education students. Firstly, this paper pointed out that digital competency not only included basic digital skills, but also involved the ability to use digital technology for learning innovation, and emphasized the core ability of teachers to complete teaching in the information-based teaching environment. Secondly, the importance and challenges of vocational education students as students, would-be teachers and technical talents are analyzed. Thirdly, it put forward some solutions to the current dilemma, such as establishing the concept of digital literacy, optimizing the curriculum system, expanding the teaching space environment and establishing a collaborative education mechanism. Finally, this paper summarized how to improve the digital literacy of vocational education normal students through these strategies, so as to adapt to the needs of education digitalization, improve the teaching quality, and promote the overall improvement of vocational education

articleTitle: Research on Human-Machine Hybrid Enhanced Programming Teaching Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Human-machine hybrid enhanced intelligence, as a cutting-edge technology in the advancement of artificial intelligence, can provide dynamic support for innovative developments in intelligent education characterized by human-machine collaboration. Addressing the prevalent issue in current university programming courses where learning feedback relies excessively on either the teacher or machine, it is of great theoretical and practical significance to explore the tripartite composite subject hybrid enhanced teaching model. Based on the principles of human-machine hybrid-enhanced intelligence, Robert Gagne’s instructional process, and perspectives on learning feedback, a programming teaching model of "teacher-machine-student" hybrid enhancement is proposed. This model was applied to a C language course at a certain university, involving 141 students from three classes. The aim is to provide insights into the application of artificial intelligence technologies in programming education. The results demonstrate that the proposed model accurately identifies issues in programming teaching and promptly delivers personalized learning feedback, thereby enhancing teaching effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on the Formation Mechanism and Bridging Path of University Teachers' Digital Chasm from the Perspective of Technology Availability
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The deep integration of teachers and technology has become an irreversible general trend, while the "digital Chasm" problem, like a barrier, hinders the overall improvement of educational equity and quality, and becomes a key issue to be solved urgently. Through literature combing, the connotation of Digital Chasm has gone beyond the difference of network environment configuration at the physical level, focusing on the difference of intelligent interaction level from the perspective of technological availability. The core of the way to bridge the "digital Chasm"of university teachers lies in the fact that teachers can actively and continuously interact and integrate with technical subjects in different educational situations. Faculty’s personal iteration is the key driving force to cross the current "digital Chasm" barrier of university faculty. Based on the value concept of balancing the equality of educational opportunities with the balanced distribution of resources, it is necessary to form a consensus and resultant force to explore the way to bridge the digital Chasm of university teachers from the following four dimensions. Firstly, We should strengthen the construction of teachers' subject identity in the practice of educational informatization. Secondly, We should create a big educational data model for all teachers to share. Thirdly, We should enhance teachers’ digital thinking and literacy. Lastly, We should strengthen the construction of teachers’ subject identity in the practice of educational informatization. The fourth is to enrich and optimize digital application scenarios in educational institutions.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the scaffolded teaching framework based on problem-solving ability training ——Take the computer network technology course as an example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The existing literature does not extensively explore the development of students' problem-solving skills in applied higher education schools. This paper proposes a teaching framework for cultivating students' problem-solving ability in higher applied education schools. Focusing on the field of applied higher education, problem-solving skills play an important role in the training of applied technicians. Will the proposed teaching framework based on the development of problem-solving skills improve the problem-solving ability of students in higher applied education schools? This study combines literature analysis, case analysis, classroom observation, etc., combined with the characteristics of computer network technology and the elements of problem-solving ability, and constructs a scaffolding teaching model for cultivating students' problem-solving ability. The experimental study combined with the questionnaire survey method verified the experimental effect from three aspects: problem-solving ability, academic performance and learning attitude. The results show that: Compared with the control class, the problem-solving skills of the students in the experimental class have improved significantly, and their academic performance is more outstanding. The students in the experimental class maintain a positive attitude towards using the Scaffolding teaching model based on problem-solving skills.

articleTitle: Minimal-norm solution for Fredholm integral equation of the first kind with degenerate kernel implemented in finite steps
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article focuses on the Fredholm integral equation of the first kind with degenerate kernel in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space(RKHS). By applying the H-Hk formulation, an analytical minimal-norm solution is derived. Additionally, a sequential design approach is employed utilizing Gaussian process regression, which provides a fairly accurate approximation with the same quantity of observation points. Lastly, the viability of the proposed method is demonstrated through some illustrative examples.

Author Keywords: Fredholm integral equation of the first kind

articleTitle: Automatic Pre-estimating of Optimal Imaging Frequency in bSSFP-based Cardiac Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMRI), balanced steady-state free precession (bSSFP) is a widely used technique. However, this technique is susceptible to resonance frequency shift artifacts, which can severely affect image quality and limit the clinical application of CMRI. Achieving a homogeneous field through gasket adjustment and high-order shimming is particularly challenging in the bSSFP technique for cardiac applications due to cardiac and respiratory movements. Additionally, the current measurement of the optimal imaging frequency with frequency scouting sequence still requires additional imaging and can produce deviations due to visual inspection errors. To address these issues, we proposed an effective automatic method to estimate the optimal imaging frequency in the region of interest by combining echo peak characteristics with a frequency scouting sequence. The frequency shift is simulated by changing the phase of the transmitting pulse, and the optimal imaging frequency is then calculated according to the echo peak characteristics. Experimental results demonstrated that our method achieves superior results compared to traditional methods and the frequency scouting method. Furthermore, our approach remarkably reduces calibration time and facilitates the clinical cardiac application of bSSFP technique.

articleTitle: A method for controlling crowd congestion based on spatial-temporal graph neural network and improved artificial bee colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel crowd congestion control method that combines spatial-temporal graph neural network with improved artificial bee colony algorithm to better integrate congestion prediction with path regulation in evacuation scenarios. First, crowd data is collected via smartphones using the PDR algorithm, and a real-time knowledge graph (RTKG) is constructed to represent the evacuation scenario. Spatial and temporal features are extracted using a two-layer graph convolutional network (TL-GCN) and a gated recurrent unit with attention (A-GRU) to predict congestion levels. These predictions are integrated into the RTKG. The INFABC algorithm then guides path planning based on these predictions. In this paper, we propose a crowd congestion control system and apply it to crowd evacuation. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method enhances the efficiency of crowd evacuation and offers crucial guidance for managing large-scale crowds.

articleTitle: The deep integration of digital technology with teacher education and teaching within the TPACK framework in the digital intelligence era
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the digital age, the field of education has undergone profound changes. With digital technology as its cornerstone, the digital age has permeated various aspects of education and teaching, leading to significant transformations in the way educational activities are conducted. The purpose of this paper is to construct a framework for teachers' knowledge structure in education under the TPACK (Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge) theory and to explore a teaching framework for the in-depth integration of digital technology into teachers' education and teaching. This aims to help teachers better adapt to digital technology and avoid the emergence of the mentality of "technology fear". The paper analyzes the necessity of the deep integration of digital technology into teacher education and teaching from the perspectives of research background and policy analysis. It further explores strategies to enhance this integration under the TPACK framework, providing theoretical references on how to improve teachers' digital technology competence in the era of digital intelligence.

articleTitle: Utilizing Data Mining Techniques to Analyze the Relationship Between Daily Flexibility and Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study employs advanced data mining techniques to explore the relationship between daily academic flexibility and performance, with a focus on the mediating role of the classroom psychological environment. Data from 946 students at a rural boarding school were analyzed through a systematic data mining process that included data collection, preprocessing, feature selection, and model training. Key techniques used were decision trees, random forests, and logistic regression models. The preprocessing steps involved handling missing values and outliers to ensure data integrity. Feature selection was crucial in identifying the most influential variables. The analysis revealed significant positive correlations between the classroom environment, daily academic flexibility, and performance. The findings underscore the effectiveness of data mining in uncovering insights that demonstrate how a supportive classroom environment enhances performance and academic flexibility. This approach highlights the utility of sophisticated data mining methods in educational research to optimize learning environments and improve student outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Knowledge Graph for the Course of Automatic Control Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The use of educational knowledge graph can help teachers and students quickly grasp the development trends of disciplines and the basic knowledge system of courses, promote efficient use of knowledge, and generate new teaching models. Taking the course of Automatic Control Principles as an example, the method of constructing a multi-modal course knowledge graph is elaborated in detail in this paper, which is implemented through means such as extracting knowledge entities, designing entity attributes, mining association relationships, and visualizing knowledge, with the course teaching as the goal and the textbook as the input. On this basis, the teaching application research of Automatic Control Principles course based on knowledge graph have been carried out, in order to provide reference for the application of intelligent technology in teaching.

articleTitle: Programming Error Classification Method for Novices based on BiLSTM-TextCNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to help programming novices locate programming errors and understand error cause, and to achieve accurate classification of programming errors, an error classification method based on deep learning networks has been proposed. Firstly, a dataset comprising 10,287 student C language programming errors (CPE28) was constructed, annotated with programming messages indicating either errors or warnings, and categorized into 28 error types to facilitate error feedback research. Secondly, the BLT-PECNet model, integrating BiLSTM and TextCNN, was designed for training and identifying programming error categories. BiLSTM captures contextual features and extracts global semantic information, while TextCNN performs convolution operations of varying sizes to extract multi-level features, ultimately yielding the classification results for programming errors. Experimental results on CPE28 demonstrate that the proposed method achieves over 92% in classification accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. It surpasses traditional single models in capturing key features of code errors, underscoring the method’s efficacy and accuracy.

articleTitle: Forecasting Talent Development in Control Engineering: Insights from the Markov Model Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study aims to delve into the training mode of talents in the field of control engineering within the context of vocational education. It focuses on theoretical construction, frontier exploration, in-depth analysis, as well as the implementation strategy and efficacy evaluation. Firstly, it highlights the current development trends and talent demands in the field of control engineering, establishing the theoretical framework for modern vocational education in talent cultivation. Secondly, it conducts a diagnosis of the current educational situation and challenges, proposing a strategic talent training mode that emphasizes the innovation of curriculum design and the integration of educational resources. Furthermore, it constructs a multidimensional evaluation mechanism to ensure the effectiveness and feasibility of the training mode. Finally, the article introduces the Markov model to predict and analyze the training effects, covering aspects such as student satisfaction with courses and employment data, providing theoretical guidance and practical references for the training of talents in control engineering. This study contributes to the formation of a more efficient and forward-looking training mode for talents in control engineering, meeting the demands of modern society and industries.

articleTitle: Analysis of Two Papers Based on RSA Algorithm: Plagiarism Investigation of HRSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The RSA algorithm, as one of the cornerstones in the field of cyber security, has always received widespread attention and research. Many scholars have published relevant research papers. This article focuses on the highly similar issues between the conference paper "Hybrid Security RSA Algorithm in Application of Web Service" published in 2018 at the 1st International Conference on Data Intelligence and Security and the paper "A Hybrid Security Algorithm for RSA Encryption system" published in 2017 at the International Conference on Advanced Computing and Communication Systems. By comparing algorithm details, experimental data differences, innovative points, and other possible academic misconduct, the aim is to provide readers with a comprehensive and in-depth understanding. This article first introduces the background and importance of the RSA algorithm, followed by a detailed analysis of the main content and research results of the two papers, and then explores their similarities and differences by comparing experimental data and algorithm details. Finally, the article will objectively evaluate the possible plagiarism behavior in the two papers based on academic norms and research ethics, and provide corresponding suggestions and reflections.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Football Match Results Based on XGBoost and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: There is a wide variety of data involved in football matches, including static and dynamic data such as team history and odds data. This diversity leads to limitations in the predictive accuracy of single models for football match outcomes. In order to improve the accuracy of prediction of football match results, this paper uses a combination of XGBoost and LSTM models to predict football match results. By using the collected static data such as player rankings, team rankings, weather conditions, etc., as features, input the XGBoost model to predict the probability of the game result, and then use the predicted outcome probability as the model's prior knowledge, fuse it with the odds change data, and input it into the LSTM model to get a more accurate prediction of the game result. Experimental results show that the proposed method has achieved good results in the prediction of football match results, and provides a useful reference for the research and practice in related fields.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Construction Mode of Industry-education Integrated Curriculum System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper studies the integrated curriculum system of industry and education based on knowledge graph, and aims to solve the problem of education system adapting to industrial changes and the evaluation of students' ability. In view of the dilemma of difficult to grasp the industrial demand and the lack of industrial perspective in students' ability evaluation, the strategy with knowledge graph as the core is put forward, and the course system is accurately reflected and optimized through real-time analysis of job information. In terms of methods, knowledge ontology is constructed, industrial demand data is extracted to realize the connection between curriculum and atlas, and dynamic update mechanism is designed to ensure the timeliness of content. The practice shows that this model significantly improves the fit of curriculum and industry, and promotes the synchronization of students' ability and industrial development. This study provides a new path and strong support for the construction of industry-education integration curriculum system and the deep integration of education chain and industrial chain.

articleTitle: Construction of a Diversified Teaching Evaluation Index System for Integrated Care Service Talents Under the Background of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Currently, the integrated care services have become a focus of social attention. However, the teaching evaluation indicators for this service are monolithic, the evaluation methods are outdated, and there is a notable lack of comprehensiveness, objectivity, and innovation. To improve the quality of talent cultivation, the construction of a diversified teaching evaluation index system under the background of informatization is of great significance. This paper mainly applies questionnaire survey, interview, and empirical research to construct the teaching evaluation index system, conducts research on the relevance, consistency, and commonality of these indexes, and scores the evaluation indexes through hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive judgment. The survey data showed that the consistency of the service level was 0.006 and the weight value was 0.31. The consistency of the product is the lowest with the smallest weight value. It can be seen that the service of medical care talents has a greater impact, and the impact of products is small.

articleTitle: Intelligent Accident Avoidance System for Traffic Accidents
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of rapid development within the automotive industry, to ensure that vehicles receive prompt rescue in the event of a crash, thereby minimizing casualties, a crash alert system based on acceleration sensors has been designed. At its core, the system employs the STM32C8T6 as the main controller, complemented by modules such as the MPU6050 and Beidou Navigation System. Utilizing a 4G module, the system seamlessly uploads data to a server, while also incorporating a mobile app to facilitate data display and interactive communication with users. In essence, this creates a truly integrated hardware-4G-mobile app collaborative system.

articleTitle: Medical Application of Logistics Information Technology in the CoVid-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The Newcastle epidemic is raging within and outside of China. It has become a public health event of great concern worldwide. This paper focuses on the current situation of medical application of logistics informatization in the CoVid-19 epidemic in China, combine the characteristics of the CoVid-19 epidemic, and proposes the use of logistics informatization to establish a logistics integration platform to maximize the timely, efficient, accurate and flexible delivery of logistics informatization to the location of the emergency to the masses affected by the CoVid-19 epidemic, and maximize the safety of people's lives.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation and Entrepreneurship Ability Cultivating Model of Computer Major Students Under the Background of New Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study constructs a "1 + 2" talent training model to promote the deep integration of innovation and entrepreneurship education and professional education. Relying on the discipline competition platform, the model of "promoting learning, teaching and creation through competition" is advocated. The establishment of the "double tutorial system" teaching team, which combines both inside and outside the school, creates a diversified teaching team of innovation and entrepreneurship education. This study provides strong support for cultivating students' innovation and entrepreneurship ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Value-added Evaluation of Vocational Education Based on Decision Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Value-added evaluation is an important exploration direction for education evaluation in the new era. Empowering value-added evaluation with artificial intelligence is a new trend in education reform in the information age. Introducing AI based value-added evaluation methods in vocational education is conducive to promote high-quality development of vocational education. This article first elaborates on the basic connotation of value-added evaluation in vocational education in relevant work. Secondly, it reviews the development process of decision tree models in the field of educational evaluation; In addition, the rationality of using machine learning algorithms to assist in implementing value-added evaluation is discussed. The following elaborates on the application principles of decision tree models in value-added evaluation. In the experimental section, a decision tree model was used to conduct value-added evaluation and analysis of student performance in computer network course at a vocational secondary school. Finally, the experimental results were analyzed and corresponding teaching suggestions were proposed.

articleTitle: Research on an Automatic Tomato Pest and Disease Recognition Algorithm Based on ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Tomatoes are highly nutritious, and as the scale of their cultivation continues to expand, accurately and efficiently identifying pests and diseases is crucial for their management. Traditional methods for identifying tomato pests and diseases primarily rely on manual techniques, which are not only inefficient and inaccurate but also costly. The automatic identification of tomato pests and diseases based on deep learning can achieve accurate and efficient detection, offering significant practical value. Building on existing networks, we proposed an automatic tomato pest and disease identification method based on ResNet50. First, the pre-trained ResNet50 is used to extract global features from images of tomato pests and diseases. Then, an efficient attention mechanism module is added in series to the network, allowing the model to effectively integrate global and local feature information, thereby improving identification accuracy. Experimental comparisons with existing classical network models show that our proposed model achieves a recognition accuracy of 98.85%, demonstrating significant advantages.

Author Keywords: Automatic identification of tomato pests and diseases

articleTitle: Research on Road Pothole Detection and Area Estimation Based on Transfer Learning and U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To address the issue of inadequate accuracy in traditional target detection and edge feature extraction algorithms for pothole detection on roads, this paper proposes a pothole detection and area estimation method based on transfer learning and the U-Net model. The method employs a pre-trained ResNet50 transfer learning model for pothole recognition and integrates the U-Net semantic segmentation model to achieve precise edge detection and area estimation of potholes. To enhance the model's performance, various data augmentation techniques were applied to the training dataset. Through comprehensive multi-dimensional evaluation, the recognition rate of the transfer learning model reached 95%, demonstrating excellent robustness and generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the U-Net model, utilizing the pre-trained ResNet50 as the backbone feature extraction network, performed outstandingly in pothole area estimation, achieving a mean Intersection over Union (mIOU) and mean Pixel Accuracy (mPA) of 91.67% and 94.99%, respectively. In conclusion, the proposed method offers significant application value in pothole recognition, edge detection, and area estimation on roads.

Author Keywords: Road pothole detection and area estimation

articleTitle: Bearing fault diagnosis method based on 1D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in feature extraction and fault identification caused by the strong nonlinearity of bearing vibration signals and the redundancy of irrelevant features, this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis method based on one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN). This method combines the temporal characteristics of bearing data, performs one-dimensional convolution (Conv1D) processing on the traditional convolutional neural network, pre-processes the original data by Fourier time-frequency domain analysis and simple data normalization, and uses sklearn to design and construct the network structure to achieve real-time prediction and diagnosis of bearing faults. Compared with the traditional CNN model, 1D-CNN has fewer network parameters and powerful feature extraction capabilities. The verification experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve 100% accuracy in the bearing fault diagnosis task, and has certain relative advantages compared with other traditional machine learning methods. This method has high classification accuracy and generalization ability for the diagnosis of rolling bearing faults.

articleTitle: SRL-Net: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks in Lacrimal Duct Obstruction Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: CT-DCG is a common dacryocystography method used for diagnosing lacrimal duct obstruction (LDO) in patients, whose interpretation relies on the expertise of doctors.In recent years, deep learning technology has seen widespread application in medical imaging. However, due to the relative scarcity of CT-DCG imaging data, challenges remain in applying deep learning network models to diagnose lacrimal duct obstructions. Our goal is to propose a deep learning model called SRL-Net based on CT-DCG imaging data to improve the accuracy of lacrimal duct diagnosis. SRL-Net achieved an accuracy of 86.39%, a recall rate of 67.26%, and a precision of 67.23% on a CT-DCG dataset for lacrimal duct obstructions.Compared to other representative deep learning network models, SRL-Net demonstrates superior diagnostic performance on the CT-DCG dataset.

articleTitle: A Dual Predictive Autoencoder-Based Model for Diabetes Prediction : Utilizing Supervised Learning and Feature Extraction with an Autoencoder for Accurate Diabetes Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Early prediction of diabetes is crucial for timely diagnosis and treatment. In this study, we propose a Dual Predictive Autoencoder (DP-AE) model for diabetes prediction, aiming to enhance feature learning and classification accuracy. The experimental results demonstrate that the DP-AE model achieves an accuracy of 0.746, precision of 0.739, recall of 0.708, an F1 score of 0.715, and an AUC score of 0.81. Compared to the second-ranked Autoencoder (AE) model, the DP-AE model shows improvements of approximately 3.76% in accuracy, 3.51% in recall, and 3.77% in F1 score. Moreover, the DP-AE model outperforms the second-ranked Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) model by approximately 4.67% in terms of precision and 2.53% in terms of AUC. These findings highlight the potential of the DP-AE model as a valuable tool for diabetes prediction, enabling early detection and intervention for individuals at risk.

articleTitle: Research on the Matching Teaching Reform of Higher Mathematics for Economic Management Majors
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper focuses on the matching teaching reform of higher mathematics for economic management majors. Through in-depth analysis of the existing problems in the current teaching, the targeted reform strategies are discussed. It emphasizes being oriented by professional demands, optimizing teaching content, integrating practical cases, and stimulating students' interest in learning. Through the reform, the aim is to improve the practicability and pertinence of higher mathematics teaching in economic management majors, and provide strong support for cultivating high-quality talents with a solid mathematical foundation and professional application ability.

articleTitle: A Proof of unsecure in the polynomial time for the XOR of two random variables
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Xoring (Exclusive-OR) two variables is a very simple way to build pseudorandom functions from pseudorandom permutations. The aim of this paper proves it may insecure for this type of form A⊕B when the two variables run XOR operation on specific environment. Because such constructions have many applications in cryptography, the problem is interesting from both theoretical and practical points of view. In this paper we will prove that for form A⊕B, we have in fact already unsecure when A and B are two numbers data type. The research results and conclusions are drawn at the end.

articleTitle: Research on Strategies for Cultivating and Enhancing Science and Technology Innovation Ability of Students Based on Higher Education Resource Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
