abstract: In order to enhance the scientific and technological innovation ability of university students and fully utilize the unbalanced high-quality resource sharing platform of various universities, this article proposes a strategy for cultivating and enhancing the scientific and technological innovation ability of university students based on the higher education resource sharing platform. This strategy can connect various high-quality resources scattered in different universities, including computing resources, storage resources, software resources, data resources, etc., into a logical whole, providing a convenient and transparent platform for cultivating scientific and technological innovation capabilities of students scattered in different regions. Based on the constituent elements, internal structure, and interaction between elements of cultivating and enhancing the innovation ability of local engineering university students, six specific strategies for cultivating and enhancing the scientific and technological innovation ability of university students based on the higher education resource sharing platform are proposed.

Author Keywords: student's ability to innovate in science and technology

articleTitle: Study on the Development of a Diabetes Health Education Promotion Program Utilizing an Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The number of patients with diabetes is rising as living standards rise, but there is a lack of passion among them for diabetes health education. This study employs the Fogg Behavior Model (FBM) as the theoretical framework, combining it with information-based health education strategies to develop a diabetes health education promotion campaign centered around an information platform. The program encompasses the interactive interface design and the execution of health education activities. This program tackles challenges such as apathy towards learning, limited self-discipline, idleness, and procrastination that have persisted. Its ultimate aim is to encourage students to become proficient in diabetes knowledge and skills and apply them to their daily self-care routines. Doing so aims to effectively manage the condition, minimize complications, and enhance the overall quality of life.

articleTitle: Observation on the clinical efficacy of plum blossom needle assisted treatment for male androgenic alopecia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Evaluate the clinical efficacy of plum blossom needle treatment for male androgenic alopecia. Method: Eighty male patients with androgenic alopecia who visited the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from January 2022 to December 2022 were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with finasteride tablets, while the observation group was treated with plum blossom needle tapping on the basis of the control group. Compare the treatment efficacy and symptom scores between two groups of patients.Result: The total effective rate of the observation group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05); The symptom scores of both groups of patients after treatment were lower than before treatment, and the difference was statistically significant (P<0.05); The symptom scores of the observation group after treatment were significantly lower than those of the control group, and the difference was statistically significant (P<0.05). Conclusion: The use of plum blossom needle as an adjuvant therapy for androgenic alopecia can significantly improve clinical efficacy, promote hair growth, and improve patient clinical symptoms.

articleTitle: Observation on the therapeutic effect of acupoint application therapy combined with Western medicine in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Observe the application effect of acupoint application therapy combined with Western medicine treatment in children with bronchopneumonia. Method: Seventy pediatric patients with bronchopneumonia admitted to the Department of Pediatrics at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from September 2022 to April 2023 were randomly divided into two groups, with 35 cases in each group, using a random number table method. The control group received conventional Western medicine treatment, while the treatment group received additional acupoint application treatment on this basis. After 7 days of intervention, compare the treatment effects, symptoms, and signs improvement between the two groups. Result: The total effective rate of the treatment group (97.1%) was significantly higher than that of the control group (77.2%), and the treatment group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05); The treatment group had significantly shorter fever relief time, cough and sputum resolution time, and chest X-ray inflammation absorption time compared to the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: Acupoint application combined with Western medicine in the treatment of children with bronchophenitis can further promote the improvement of patients' symptoms, with high safety, significantly shorten the time for symptom improvement, and enhance the curative effect.

Author Keywords: Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine

articleTitle: Agent Decision Model Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning in Artificial Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to explore the impact of reinforcement learning on agent decision in agent-based computational finance models, the dueling network architectures is introduced to construct the stock market agent decision-making model based on the deep Q network, and the stock market trading strategy is learned by maximizing the return on investment. The realistic trading data are used for model training. The experiment shows that agent can determine when to buy and sell to obtain positive rewards, and can learn the investment strategy of holding for a long time to increase the final return. The research in this paper enables the agent-based computational finance model to simulate the microstructure of the stock market in a more realistic way.

articleTitle: Analysis of High-Quality Information Technology Lessons Based on S-T Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Education digitization has revolutionized teaching methods and models, necessitating educators' conceptual and capability upgrades. Teachers must engage in rigorous, holistic self-reflection on classroom practices. Researchers primarily rely on Student-Teacher (S-T) analysis to quantify the dynamics of teaching and learning, yet frequently overlook the possible complexity and diversity in the process. This paper augments S-T analysis with innovative multi-faceted data collection on teacher-student behaviors, dynamically analyzing Information Technology (IT) theory and practical courses. Ultimately, the application of this methodology reveals the strengths and weaknesses of both course types, offering targeted guidance and recommendations for IT teachers to effectively conduct classroom instruction.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effectiveness of Mobile Inquiry-Based Learning for PICC Catheter Patients Based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To design and create a virtual simulation training platform for PICC catheterization and to explore the effects of mobile inquiry-based learning on PICC patient care. Methods: A PICC patient care learning platform was developed using virtual simulation technology. Students from one class of the 2021 nursing students were randomly selected as the control group, while another class served as the observation group. The observation group used a VR-based mobile inquiry-based learning model, whereas the control group followed traditional teaching methods. The teaching effects were then compared. Results: The observation group outperformed the control group in theoretical scores, practical operation assessment, clinical communication skills, critical thinking abilities, teaching satisfaction, and qualitative interview outcomes. Conclusion: The VR-based mobile inquiry-based learning model for PICC patient care stimulated students' learning enthusiasm, promoted self-directed learning, enhanced communication skills, and ensured teaching quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Progress of blood-activating and blood-stasis-removing herbs combined with shoulder arthroscopy in repairing rotator cuff injury: a meta-analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the differences in clinical efficacy of different blood-activating and blood-stasis-removing Chinese herbal formulas combined with shoulder arthroscopy for repairing rotator cuff injuries by reticulation meta-analysis, with a view to providing evidence-based basis for clinical diagnosis and treatment. METHODS: Relevant randomized controlled trials were searched in CNKI, Wanfang VIP, Wipro, PubMed, Web Of Science, and Cochrane Library, and the retrieval time was from the construction of the library to August 2023. Net meta-analysis was performed using RevMan 5.4, Stata 18.0 software. Results: A total of 9 RCTs were included in the literature, involving 558 patients with rotator cuff injury. Reticulated meta-analysis showed that Taohong Siwu decoction (RR=1.19 ,95%CI (1.00,1.41)), Buyang Huanwu decoction (RR=1.32, 95%CI (1.11,1.57)) were superior to simple arthroscopy group in terms of improving the clinical efficacy rate, FuYuan Huoxue decoction (RR=1.13 95% CI (0.97,1.32)) did not differ statistically from the simple arthroscopy group; the area under the curve of the cumulative probability plot was in the following order: Taohong Siwu decoction > Buyang Huanwu decoction > FuYuan Huoxue decoction > simple arthroscopy group. In terms of improving postoperative UCLA scores, Buyang Huanwu decoction (MD=4.56,95% CI (3.97,5.15)), Shentong Zhuyu decoction (MD=1.33,95%CI (0.28,2.38)), Huoxue Lishui decoction (MD=1.53,95%CI (0.82, 2.23)), Shujin Huoxue decoction (MD=3.09,95%CI(1.71,4.47)), Huoxue Zhitong decoction (MD=1.75,95%CI(0.92,2.58)), and Fuyuan Huoxue decoction (MD=4.57,95%CI(2.28,6.86)) were superior to the simple arthroscopy group; the cumulative probability plot area under the curve was ranked as follows: Buyang Huanwu decoction > Fuyuan Huoxue decoction >Shujin Huoxue decoction >Huoxue Zhitong decoction >Huoxue Lishui decoction >Shentong Zhuyu decoction > simple arthroscopy group. CONCLUSION: When repairing rotator cuff injuries under shoulder arthroscopy, the combined use of blood-activating and blood- stasis-removing traditional Chinese medicines can improve the patients' postoperative symptoms; among them, Taohong Siwu decoction and Buyang Huanwu decoction have certain advantages.

Author Keywords: promoting blood circulation to remove blood stasis

articleTitle: Practical Exploration of BOPPS + on the Mixed Teaching Mode of Divided Classes-Take the Teaching of Business Ability Application as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article explores the practical application of the blended learning model combining BOPPPS and split classroom in the course of "Business Ability Application". By analyzing in detail the six stages of the BOPPPS model (introduction, teaching objectives, pre-test, participatory learning, post test, summary) and the three parts of the divided classroom model (lecture, independent learning, discussion), this article demonstrates how to flexibly apply these two teaching models in the course of "Business Ability Application" to enhance students' learning interest, initiative, and practical ability. Teaching practice has proven that this blended learning model can effectively improve classroom atmosphere, enhance teacher-student interaction, improve teaching effectiveness, and cultivate compound talents with solid business skills and innovative spirit.

articleTitle: Clinical observation of acupoint application therapy combined with Jinzhen oral liquid in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Observe the clinical efficacy of acupoint application therapy combined with Jinzhen oral liquid in the treatment of pediatric bronchopneumonia. Method: Sixty children with bronchopneumonia admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from December 2022 to June 2023 were selected as the research subjects and randomly divided into two groups, with 30 cases in each group. The control group was treated with amoxicillin and potassium clavulanate granules, while the combination group was treated with acupoint patches and Jinzhen oral liquid in addition to the control group. After one week of intervention, compare the improvement of traditional Chinese medicine syndrome scores, clinical efficacy, and adverse reactions between the two groups. Result: The improvement of traditional Chinese medicine syndrome scores in the combined group of patients after treatment was better than that in the control group, and the difference was statistically significant (P<0.05); The total effective rate of the combination group treatment (93.33%) was higher than that of the control group (73.33%), and P<0.05; There was no statistically significant difference (P>0.05) in the comparison of adverse reactions between the two groups of pediatric patients. Conclusion: Acupoint application combined with Jinzhen oral liquid can further improve symptoms and enhance clinical efficacy in children with bronchopneumonia, and has high safety.

Author Keywords: Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine

articleTitle: Development of An AI Desktop Assistant based on ESP32 : Practice on Experiential Learning in Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the present study, we have attempted to implement experiential learning (EL) which is, in particular, considering to including practice of using generative AI in the learning contents, in education of the discipline of mechatronics and robotics. In particular, we introduce to students knowledge of generative AI, and their role in modern engineering systems, as well as encouraging them to practice relevant technology in their group projects. We have presented a typical case study of a student group project, which efficiently practices EL integrated with generative AI technology, i.e. the development of an AI desktop assistant, in which students have practiced and integrated in the device the following AI-based technology. Results and outcomes can readily show that the developed AI desktop assistant boasts impeccable functions and is highly in line with the demands of the present education market. Meanwhile, such projects examples, under the EL framework, whilst integrated with recent AI technology, can greatly motivate students’ learning and their performance.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Case Library of “Education Message Technology Special Topic” based on GeoGebra
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Case teaching is an important way to promote the organic integration of teaching and practice, and an important means to promote the reform of the training mode of professional degree postgraduates. This paper first discusses the significance of the construction of the case base of "Education Message Technology Special Topic" course, then it gives the implementation process of case base construction from four aspects, such as teaching case design principle, teaching case design method, concrete case construction content, concrete case display and evaluation, finally, the expected results and prospects are outlined in detail.

articleTitle: The construction and practice of information technology courses that integrate new generation of information technology and empowering education
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Starting from the background of the construction of new engineering disciplines and the demand for empowering education, this paper analyzes the current teaching situation of information technology courses in applied local undergraduate universities, and explores the new situation faced by the reform of university information technology courses. It explores new ideas for the reform of university information technology courses, mainly from three aspects: upgrading course modules, optimizing evaluation systems, and empowering new technologies. It studies the path and methods of information technology course reform in engineering majors.

articleTitle: Observation of the Clinical Efficacy of Dingchuan Decoction in the Treatment of Bronchial Asthma
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study the clinical effectiveness of Dingchuan Tang in treating bronchial asthma. Method: Sixty patients with bronchial asthma were selected and randomly divided into an observation group and a control group according to a random number table, with 30 cases in each group. The control group received conventional Western medicine treatment, while the treatment group received Dingchuan Tang treatment on the basis of the control group's treatment. Compare the clinical treatment effects, ACT scores, and TCM syndrome scores between the two groups after 2 weeks of intervention. Result: The total effective rate of the observation group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). The treatment group was significantly better than the control group in improving the ACT score and total score of traditional Chinese medicine symptoms in patients (P<0.05). Conclusion: Dingchuan Tang has good clinical efficacy in treating bronchial asthma and is worthy of clinical promotion and application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chinese medicine treatment pattern of gastric precancerous lesions based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To analyze the rules of Chinese medicine treatment of chronic atrophic gastritis and gastric precancerous lesions using data mining method to provide reference for clinical diagnosis and treatment. Methods: All the case data came from the outpatient clinic of Professor Li Diangui of Hebei Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine from January 2023 to December 2024, where Professor Li Diangui personally diagnosed and treated the outpatients with chronic atrophic gastritis with intestinal epithelial hyperplasia and atypical hyperplasia, and analyzed data standardization and statistical analysis of the terms such as Chinese medicine disease name, clinical symptoms, tongue manifestation, pulse manifestation, and Chinese medicine syndrome of the medical case, Chinese medicine treatment and other terms for data standardization and statistical analysis.Results: A total of 118 cases were included, of which 54 cases (45.76%) were male and 64 cases (54.23%) were female, with more females than males. The Chinese medicine high-frequency syndrome types were, in descending order, turbid toxin, incoordination between liver and stomach, spleen-stomach weakness, stomach-channel stagnation, and cold-heat mismatch. The disease sites were mainly in the liver, spleen, stomach, and lungs, and the pathologies were mainly turbid toxin, qi stagnation, and qi deficiency. Conclusion: The treatment of chronic atrophic gastritis and gastric precancerous lesions is based on the theory of liver, spleen and stomach, with the accumulation of turbid toxin and incoordination between liver and stomach as the core pathogenesis in the process of development, and turbid toxin, phlegm-heat and qi stagnation as the core elements, so the treatment is based on removing turbidity and resolving toxins, dispersing stagnated liver qi for regulating stomach, and also elevating and de-elevating the qi mechanism.

articleTitle: The Reform of Talent Cultivation Mode for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Modern Industrial Colleges Based on the Agile Education Philosophy
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, profound changes have occurred in the demand for talents. The traditional talent cultivation mode is difficult to meet the needs of current industrial development and urgently needs reform. This paper proposes a series of specific reform measures and explores the reform path of talent cultivation modes for big data and AI majors in modern industrial colleges, based on an in-depth analysis of the agile education philosophy and the characteristics of modern industrial colleges, hoping to provide valuable references for talent cultivation in the field of big data and AI in China.

articleTitle: Research on the application of hierarchical hybrid teaching mode integrating curriculum ideological and political education in university computer basic courses
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study aims to explore the integration of ideological and political elements in basic computer courses in universities and improve teaching efficiency and students' comprehensive quality through the implementation of hierarchical blended teaching reforms. The research adopted a method that combines teaching design, practical application and effect evaluation to build a hybrid teaching platform that combines online and offline teaching resources. This study shows that the hierarchical blended teaching model adopted effectively improves students' academic motivation, classroom participation and educational satisfaction, and significantly promotes the development of their critical thinking and innovation skills.

Author Keywords: ideological and political education in courses

articleTitle: Autonomous Surface Vehicle for Unmanned Inspection and Cruising on Water
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the explosion of the industrial revolution, the rapid rise of industry has not only brought about rapid economic development, but also directly or indirectly led to many environmental problems, including water pollution, air pollution, solid waste pollution, and other types of pollution. Due to the in-depth development of industries and the accumulation of environmental problems over the years, the level of pollution around the world is constantly increasing, and environmental protection has become an urgent issue that needs attention and resolution. To alleviate the pressure on the world's ecology, Chinese leaders have proposed the "Sustainable Development Strategy." Among various environmental issues, solving the problem of water pollution is of paramount importance. Water quality testing has become an essential and critical link in the process of addressing water pollution.

articleTitle: FastDTW-Encoded Spatial-temporal Attention Dual Graph Convolutional Network for Traffic Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Addressing the insufficient extraction of traffic network topology features and inadequate topological feature extraction and spatial-temporal dependency modeling in traffic flow prediction, we construct a dual graph convolutional network algorithm based on fast Dynamic Time Warping (fastDTW) and spatial-temporal attention mechanism (STADGCN). Firstly, the spatial-temporal attention module is employed to capture the dynamic influence weights of the spatial-temporal dimensions. Secondly, fastDTW is utilized to measure similarity between nodes in the traffic network, enhancing topology-based feature extraction through adjacency matrix encoding. Subsequently, dual graph convolutional and temporal convolutional networks are constructed to algorithm spatial-temporal dependencies. Finally, the prediction performance of the STADGCN algorithm is verified by a weighted fusion of recent, daily, and weekly components based on real highway network detector data. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to ARIMA, VAR, FNN, GAT, GCN, GWNet, STGCN, and ASTGCN, STADGCN exhibits superior performance with MAPE reductions of 81.97%, 64.52%, 78.85%, 69.44%, 54.17%, 8.33%, 8.33%, and 26.67% respectively, on the pems08 dataset.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Traditional Chinese Medicine for Menstrual Disorders from 2013 to 2023 Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to visually analyze the use of Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for the treatment of menstrual disorder symptoms from 2013 to 2023, using Citespace software, with the objective of understanding the field's developmental trajectory and frontier hotspots. METHODS: Relevant literature was retrieved from two major databases: China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) and WANGFANG DATA (WanFang) and a database was constructed. The data were cleaned using NoteExpress and the annual publication count was statistically analyzed using Microsoft Excel, which was imported into Citespace to map authors, institutions, and keywords (co-occurrence, clustering, and emergent words) for visualization and analysis. RESULTS: The study totally included 815 articles after data cleaning according to the inclusion criteria, with an average annual publication volume of 74. The publication volume in most years fluctuated slightly around the mean, while there were some years with significant fluctuations. The Centrality of any author and institution was 0.00, indicating a lack of communication between authors, institutions and institutions, with only a few exceptions, such as researchers from Changchun University of Chinese Medicine (CCUCM) and the Guang'anmen Hospital of the China Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine (GAMHCATCM), Beijing University of Chinese Medicine (BJUCM) and GAMHCATCM, with the highest number of publications accumulating 5 articles, but no core group of authors has been formed yet. The main theme of the literature in this field is to validate the clinical efficacy of Chinese herbal medicine in treating menstrual disorders, with decoction as the dosage form, usually taken orally after decoction or by enema. Acupuncture or combination with Western medicine may be used to enhance therapeutic effects at times. In recent years, the research hotspots are TCM compounding and TCM decoction.

articleTitle: Pathway Study of Labor Education in Chinese Vocational Undergraduate Education Based on "Three-Level" Smart Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By analyzing the objectives and functional orientation of labor education in Chinese vocational universities, this paper explores the collaborative education mechanism of labor education, empowering the theoretical teaching of labor education, innovating labor practice activities, and improving the evaluation of labor education, based on the three-level smart education platform at the national, provincial, and school levels. The paper aims to build an integrated practical labor education system that incorporates teaching, practical activities, and evaluation, to create a new digital, personalized, and collaborative labor education ecosystem of vocational universities, and to enhance the effectiveness of labor education, which helps students in vocational universities to establish correct working concepts, improve working skills and develop good working habits.

articleTitle: Application of Information Teaching Technology in Geography Classroom
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and the gradual advancement of education reform, the integration of geography teaching and information technology has attracted more and more attention. This paper aims to explore how information-based teaching technology can optimize teaching methods, improve teaching quality and efficiency, and contribute to the reform and development of geography curriculum. Through the use of questionnaires, case studies and literature analysis, this paper reviews its development history and research status. At the same time, in line with the development trend of education informatization, questionnaires are designed for teachers and students to investigate the specific application status of informatization teaching technology in current geography classes and reveal its practical application effects and problems in current high school geography classes.

articleTitle: Innovative research on the community of education and practice model of labor education in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To build a student-centered community of education and practice that integrates labor education and practice and unites the strengths of schools, enterprises, government, communities and families. The Community of Education and Practice is a community of schools, enterprises, government, communities and families. Under the model of community of education and practice, the ideological nature of labor education is kept in mind, the social nature of labor education is grasped, the practical nature of labor education is strengthened, and the coherence of labor education is highlighted. It enriches the path of labor practice that integrates education and practice, builds a scientific and efficient evaluation system for labor education, and realizes the learning, thinking, practicing and action of labor ideological education and practical education. Reasonably allocate labor education resources inside and outside the school, form an open and shared community of labor education resources, create a new pattern of labor education in which knowledge and practice go hand in hand, and resources are linked, enhance the effectiveness of labor education, and form a more solid, in-depth, and high-level model of labor education.

articleTitle: The Survey and Research of College Students’ Fragmented Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Fragmented learning refers to a learning mode, in which knowledge and information are acquired in small, discrete chunks, rather than in a continuous, structured format. This allows learners to fit learning into their daily lives, even when they have limited resources or attention. With fragmented learning, learners are able to access information quickly and easily, fitting it into their busy schedules. However, this learning mode also leads to difficulties in retaining and connecting information due to the lack of a structured framework. Through the questionnaire survey of students in the University of Jinan, this article analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of fragmented learning, and tries to improve the teaching mode to better suit contemporary college students. Finally, this article explores the use of fragmented learning to assist classroom teaching in the "Advanced Mathematics" courses, fully leveraging their respective advantages, expanding students' learning space and time, and achieving good teaching results.

articleTitle: A Practical Study on Statistical Analysis of Secondary School Achievement and Case Teaching Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Data mining is an in-depth data analysis method that can mine useful information from massive data. For secondary schools, most of the statistical achievement data are treated as query and record data, which is a waste of resources, and the use of data mining technology to analyze and process the relevant educational data can help accelerate the development of education informatization. The traditional teaching methods in secondary schools are not enough to stimulate students’ interest in learning, and it is difficult to achieve the expected learning effect. In order to solve this problem, this paper provides theoretical purposes for the comprehensive implementation of quality education in secondary schools and improving the level of vocational education, by statistically analyzing the performance of secondary schools and implementing Case teaching measures to improve the learning performance of secondary students.

articleTitle: Supervised Feature Selection Based on Improved Linear Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Feature selection method advances the performance of classification models by eliminating irrelevant and redundant features. LDA(Linear Discriminant Analysis) is a classic and efficient method for feature selection by clustering. However, the conventional LDA model is difficult to solve the problem of outlier sensitivity and sparse subspace. To solve these problems, we propose a supervised feature selection method based on improved LDA model. Firstly, the fixed norm used to judge the distance between samples in LDA is replaced by a novel adaptive norm to reduce the influence of outliers. Secondly, the sparse subspace learning model is embedded into LDA to enhance the information density of selected features. Finally, an efficient iterative algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Outlier and classification experiments on 9 real-word datasets show that the proposed algorithm is superior to other algorithms in classification performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Governance Strategies for Social Network Rumors in Sudden Events Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of social networks, the spread of rumors in emergencies poses a serious threat to social stability. This paper mainly studies the collaborative governance path of social network rumors in sudden events driven by big data. Select the typical online rumor cases published by "China Netcom" in the past five years, use big data crawler technology to obtain data sets, use social network analysis method to conduct quantitative analysis, and investigate the collaborative governance network structure of social network rumors in emergencies through multiple indicators. It is found that the network structure is loose, the interaction between main nodes is weak, the coupling of name rumor rejection users in information collection and distribution is not high, and the governance subject cannot form a joint force. The governance of sudden social network rumors needs to be led by the government, with the active participation and cooperation of media,Internet users and Internet organizations, forming a multiple collaborative linkage mechanism for rumor governance, which gathers joint forces, enriching the theory of rumor governance and improving the efficiency of rumor governance.

articleTitle: PP-Grading: Hierarchical Authorization using Polarization Pruning
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularity of neural networks, more and more service providers are providing us with convenient neural network services. In this situation, it is necessary for service providers to grant hierarchical authorization of the networks to meet the service requirements of different users. Pruning technology, as a mainstream method for modifying neural network structures, can also be applied in the hierarchical authorization of neural networks. This article uses the method of polarization pruning to decentralize and grade neural networks. Firstly, we extract the scale factors of the batch normalization(BN) layer as a measure of the importance of each channel. Then, sparse methods are used to screen for scale factors. In order to make the selected scale factors have more obvious and reasonable truncation intervals, we also use polarization methods to induce clustering of scale factors. According to different grading requirements, we prune the channels corresponding to different quantities of scale factors. The experiment proves that our method has good grading performance on different datasets and different neural networks. Moreover, good grading results can be achieved by pruning only a small portion of the channels.

articleTitle: Exploring the Blended Teaching Mode of Machine Learning by Integrating CDIO Engineering Concept
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of information technology in education and Internet technology, the adoption of online and offline blended teaching mode has become an important means of modernization of higher education. In order to cultivate students' data thinking ability, engineering practice ability and theoretical innovation ability, this paper focuses on the problems faced by the teaching of machine learning course, carries out an exploratory reform of the course teaching mode, organically integrates CDIO into the whole process of teaching and implementation, and puts forward the teaching program of machine learning course. Specifically, it introduces how to clarify the teaching goal of "student-centered", design the knowledge hierarchy and teaching process integrating CDIO, plan the blended teaching mode of online and offline. This paper also concludes how to explore innovative practice teaching oriented to competition cases, cultivate students' teamwork and innovation spirit with collaborative learning led by innovative design projects, and comprehensively enhance students' machine learning knowledge and practice ability to better cultivate data thinking and strengthen engineering practice ability, and integration of multi-disciplinary data application to cultivate students' theoretical innovation ability, effectively support the subsequent course learning of computer-related majors, so as to explore the new path of cultivating high-quality composite applied talents.

articleTitle: Intelligent trajectory planning of excavator based on artificial intelligence strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Excavators are widely used in important national fields such as agricultural water conservancy, mining, road construction and disaster relief. With the maturity of computer control, information communication technology and artificial intelligence algorithm, the long-standing technical problems of excavators have been effectively solved. Due to the multi-purpose function of the excavator, it is inevitable that it will work in some dangerous working conditions, endangering personal safety. Therefore, this paper takes excavators, the king of construction machinery, to excavate gravel as an example, and takes the length and thrust of excavating oil cylinders as optimization parameters. By using technical means such as mechanical kinematics, dynamics and virtual simulation, this paper builds a scene model of excavating materials actually by excavators. The trajectory parameters of the excavator are optimized based on the global search capability of the artificial intelligence ant colony algorithm (the essence of optimization is to optimize the length and matching of the digging oil cylinder, so that the excavator's cylinder force is transmitted to the tip of the bucket tongue in the best way, so that it can exert the maximum digging force, excavate the gravel in the shortest time, and improve production efficiency). Through mathematical models and calculation methods, the algorithm automatically finds the best intelligent trajectory, realizes the maximization of excavator operation efficiency and the improvement of motion stability, thus realizes more accurate control and safer operation of excavator, and promotes the deep integration of artificial intelligence technology and physical manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: The Application of Multi-dimensional Process Evaluation in the Course of “College Physics”
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In response to the problems with the traditional assessment of college physics courses, leveraging the instructional support features of Rain Classroom and SuperStarLearn platforms, reforms have been implemented in the conventional course assessment model, establishing a process-oriented evaluation system that integrates formative and summative assessments. During the teaching process, emphasis is placed on the procedural management and guidance of students, integrating assessments into every phase of the students’ learning process. Practice shows that the process-oriented assessment is centered on student learning, achieving significant results in fostering students’ self-learning capabilities and enhancing their classroom engagement, truly realizing a shift from focusing on students’ test scores to emphasizing learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on the Informational Management of Work Placement for Vocational College Students Based on Industry-Education Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Industry-Education Integration is a focal point of China's vocational education reform, aiming to enhance the quality and practicality of internships to meet the demand for applied talents driven by industrial upgrading. Although Industry-Education Integration contributes to improved internship quality, there still exist issues such as insufficient school-enterprise collaboration mechanisms, a disconnect between internships and actual production processes, inadequate protection of interns' rights, and lagging information management. Therefore, it is critically important to research and develop an informational management system for work placements based on the concept of Industry-Education Integration. This system should employ advanced technologies to streamline management procedures and offer personalized internship experiences. Building an integrated information management system requires scientifically formulated management regulations and the establishment of a full-process management platform tailored to the needs, enabling hierarchical and graded management along with real-time monitoring and feedback. This approach is intended to dismantle the barriers between schools and enterprises, optimize the allocation of internship resources, elevate management efficiency, safeguard students' all-round development, and further deepen the integration of industry and education.

articleTitle: Teaching innovation results based on double helix teaching strategy and ADDIE model- Take the Big Data and visualization course for example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: "Big Data Analysis and Visualization" course focuses on innovative teaching concepts and content, integrating key skills of data science and ideological and political education. This course not only focuses on teaching professional knowledge of big data processing, analysis and visualization, but also emphasizes the importance of ideological and political education to cultivate students' social responsibility and ethical concepts in the field of data science. According to the teaching pain points of students' weak data thinking ability, lack of practical project training and ideological and political thinking in this course, this paper proposes to reconstruct the "internal spectrum" and "external spectrum" of course design based on the double helix teaching strategy and ADDIE teaching mode, and the teaching objectives of the course clearly show its content structure and its connection with other fields of data science. Guided by the needs of enterprise talents, with the purpose of applying what we have learned and scenario-based case teaching, we will raise our teaching objectives and thinking to a higher level. Through online and offline mixed teaching, we will conduct reality training, practical projects and practical tests to create a composite, application-oriented and innovative talent training model that Adapts to the new situation and has the latest thinking and skills. Through practical teaching and case studies, students' engineering practice innovation ability has been significantly improved, and they have achieved excellent results in various national and provincial data science competitions, demonstrating the remarkable effect of the course in cultivating students' synthesis ability,Cultivate data science application talents with innovative thinking and cross-border integration.

articleTitle: Reform and Innovation of "2+2+3" Teaching Mode Based on PBL-CBL Teaching Method in the Classroom Teaching of Vocational Schools "Photoshop Image Processing"
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularization of image processing software and technology, the construction of a high-quality classroom for Photoshop Image Processing is of great significance for secondary vocational schools to improve the content and efficiency of teaching and to cultivate high-quality talents with both "virtue and ability". According to the characteristics of the course "Photoshop Image Processing" and students' learning situation, the thesis proposes a new teaching mode of "2+2+3" based on PBL-CBL teaching method. On the basis of the study of PBL-CBL teaching method, specific ideas and steps to optimize the teaching link are proposed to improve the effectiveness of teaching and enhance students’ future career resilience.

articleTitle: Research progress on traditional Chinese medicine prediction for lung cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The combination of computer technologies such as bioinformatics and network pharmacology has been widely applied in the research of traditional Chinese medicine prediction for diseases. The article mainly introduces the process of lung cancer gene screening and traditional Chinese medicine prediction methods. This article summarizes the current process of traditional Chinese medicine prediction for lung cancer and the application of commonly used technical methods.

articleTitle: Invisible Watermark and Hypothesis Testing for Multi-Ownership Verification Framework of Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, artificial intelligence models have become the core asset of tech giants, highlighting the importance of copyright protection. Black-box watermarking has gained attention due to its ability to verify the legality of models remotely without relying on internal model information. The challenges lie in embedding and verifying watermarks without accessing internal model parameters, while ensuring the robustness and stealth of the watermark. This paper focuses on discussing effective ways to protect the copyright of black-box watermarking models and detect and prevent unauthorized user behavior that infringes on model ownership. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-ownership verification framework based on invisible watermark and hypothesis testing, which mainly consists of two parts: watermark generation and copyright verification. The watermark generation uses a dynamic watermarking method to generate invisible backdoor watermark and verifies copyright through hypothesis testing. This framework has high assurance and effectiveness under various models of CIFAR-10 and MNIST datasets and shows strong robustness in VGG and Resnet model pruning attacks. This research provides new ideas and methods for the protection of model copyrights in deep neural networks.

articleTitle: Clinical results and recurrence factors analysis of platinum coils in the treatment of intracranial aneurysms
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: Analysis of clinical efficacy and risk factors for recurrence of intracranial aneurysms treated with platinum coils.Method: Collect information on the Tiantan Hospital May 2018 to January 2020 Clinical data of patients undergoing platinum coil embolization of aneurysms. Determine the risk factors for aneurysm recurrence after platinum coils embolization through univariate and multivariate analysis.Result: A total of 258 patients were enrolled in this study, The average age was 56. 2 years, and 192 patients (74. 4%) were females. The average follow-up time was 6 months, and 38 (14. 7%) aneurysms recurred. Univariate analysis showed that statistically significant differences in aneurysm location, aneurysm size, neck size of aneurysm, Hunt-Hess grade and the proportion of the volume of the coil with a diameter ≤ 1. 5mm to the volume of the aneurysm between the patients with recurrence and the patients with no recurrence ( P < 0. 05 ). Multivariate logistics regression analysis shows, Hunt-Hess grade II, Posterior circulation aneurysm, the proportion of the volume of the coil with a diameter ≤ 1. 5mm to the volume of the aneurysm were risk factors for aneurysm recurrence after platinum coil embolization. Conclusion: Posterior circulation aneurysm, Hunt- Hess grade II aneurysm, the lower proportion of the volume of the coil with a diameter ≤ 1. 5mm to the volume of the aneurysm, the higher the risk of aneurysm recurrence after coil embolization.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Undergraduate Students’Online Learning Satisfaction and Engagement Dimensions: Strategies for Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between undergraduate students' satisfaction and the various dimensions of learning engagement in an online teaching environment, and to propose corresponding improvement strategies. The study employed a quantitative research design. Participants were undergraduate students from multiple disciplines, recruited through an online survey. A total of 3548 questionnaires were collected.Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and multiple regression analysis to explore the relationships between variables. The results revealed that: the three dimensions of satisfaction—satisfaction with online teaching effectiveness, satisfaction with the technology platform, and overall satisfaction—are significantly correlated with online learning engagement; the four dimensions of online learning engagement have a significant positive impact on both satisfaction with the technology platform and satisfaction with online teaching effectiveness;in online learning engagement, cognitive and performance aspects have a significant positive impact on overall satisfaction,furthermore, gender differences in online learning satisfaction and engagement have been noted. This study concludes that attention should be paid to diverse interactions in online teaching. Teachers should tailor their instructions according to students’ gender differences and disciplines to better achieve the corresponding teaching goals. Improving online learners' engagement, particularly focusing on enhancing students’ cognitive and performance engagement, is essential.

articleTitle: Permanence of a Nonlinear Predator-prey-mutualist System
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Previous literature has assumed that the infimum of the coefficients of the internal density constraints of all populations in the system is positive when discussing ecosystem permanence. However, this assumption may not hold in a more favorable ecological environment. This paper establishes sufficient conditions to ensure system permanence under the condition that the intraspecies density-dependent coefficient of predators is nonnegative, using comparative theorem combined with subtle analysis skills.

articleTitle: Clinical efficacy of Zhenai needling method in the treatment of acute exacerbation of bronchial asthma
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study the clinical efficacy of Zhenai needling method in the treatment of acute exacerbation of bronchial asthma. Method: 70 patients with acute exacerbation of mild to moderate bronchial asthma who visited the hospital from March 2024 to July 2024 were randomly divided into a treatment group and a control group according to a random number table, with 35 cases in each group. The control group received conventional Western medicine treatment, while the treatment group received Zhenai acupuncture treatment on the basis of the control group's treatment. After one week of intervention, compare the clinical treatment effects, traditional Chinese medicine syndrome scores, and lung function indicators between the two groups. Result: The total effective rate of the treatment group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). In terms of improving the total score of clinical symptoms in patients, the treatment group was significantly better than the control group (P<0.05), and there was a statistically significant difference between the treatment group and the control group in improving pulmonary function PEF ( P<0.05). Conclusion: Zhenai needling method can alleviate clinical symptoms, improve clinical efficacy, and improve lung function in patients with bronchial asthma during the attack period, and has certain clinical efficacy.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Implementation Effect of Darrentang Equity Incentive Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The enhancement of a company's operational performance stands as an indispensable pillar, intricately woven with the impetus provided by talented individuals. To this end, an increasing number of enterprises are embracing equity incentives as a strategic tool to attract, motivate, and retain such invaluable assets. This study delves into the realm of equity incentives, specifically focusing on Darentang as our case study. Based on the Projection Pursuit Model, the implementation effects of its equity incentive program were analyzed by the genetic algorithm of analysis. It is found that equity incentive can improve the operating performance of Darentang. However, there are some defects in the design of equity incentive scheme, which leads to the unsatisfactory incentive effect of equity incentive in the later period.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Reform of Programming Courses Based on Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the application of Generative AI in the field of education is becoming increasingly widespread. This article uses CiteSpace to visually analyze the development trajectory, hot trends, and cutting-edge research of artificial intelligence applications in the field of education in China. It clarifies the necessity and feasibility of integrating generative AI with education and proposes a programming course teaching reform model based on generative AI. The aim is to explore how to use generative AI technology to reform programming courses, solve many problems in traditional teaching models through student portraits, intelligent generation of teaching content, automatic evaluation of student assignments, and providing personalized learning suggestions, in order to improve education quality and students' learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Feasible Path Search Algorithm on Two Dimensional Manifold S2
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Spherical Barrier Free RRT path search method (SBF-RRT) can be solved the problem of the feasible path search on two-dimensional manifold S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. SBF-RRT algorithm is based on RRT algorithm, an area uniform sampling model based on Monte Carlo integration method can be solved the problem of uniform random sampling on two-dimensional manifold S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The approximate distance measurement function of two-dimensional manifold surface distance between two points on manifold S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> can be obtained by arc segment proportional segmentation method. The angle cutting method can be solved the new node generation model on S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> surface. The continuous interpolation method can be solved the directed connection problem between two points on the manifold S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The SBF-RRT algorithm can be searched for a feasible path on the two-dimensional manifold S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Research on Higher Education Information Technology in China : Based on CiteSpace knowledge graph analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study examines the evolution of higher education informatisation in China using bibliometric analysis and CiteSpace knowledge graph creation. Analyzing data from the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), it identifies key developmental phases from 2000 to 2024, aligned with major educational reforms and technological advances. The research outlines three distinct stages: an exploratory phase (2000-2009), a rapid growth phase (2010-2020), and a current phase focusing on deep integration and advanced research (2021-2024). Findings emphasize the importance of inter-institutional collaboration and the shift towards intelligent education systems incorporating technologies like AI and big data. This study provides insights into the dynamic changes in higher education informatisation in China, offering a foundation for future policy and innovation.

articleTitle: Retrospective analysis of clinical efficacy of Zhisou San combined with acupoint application in the treatment of bronchial asthma
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe the efficacy and safety of Zhisou San combined with acupoint application in the clinical treatment of asthma. Method: A retrospective analysis was conducted on cases of bronchial asthma treated at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from January 2023 to July 2024. After treatment, the asthma control test score (ACT), asthma quality of life score (AQLQ), lung function indicators, and adverse events were recorded. Result: After treatment, the ACT score and AQLQ score of the patients were significantly increased compared to before treatment (P<0.05), and the FEV1, FVC, and FEV1/FVC of the patients were significantly increased, with statistical significance (P<0.05). Only 2 patients had redness and swelling on the skin at the application site, which could heal on their own. Conclusion: The combination of Zhisou powder and acupoint application is helpful in improving clinical symptoms, improving the quality of life, enhancing lung function, and has good safety, which is worthy of clinical promotion.

articleTitle: Digital empowerment and Ideological and political integration: Innovation exploration of computer network courses in secondary vocational schools under the background of the new era
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the context of the new era, vocational education plays a crucial role in cultivating both technical skills and ethical values. Taking computer network courses as an example, this paper adheres to the core principle of moral education, starting from enhancing teachers' digital literacy, advocating for digital awareness, and mastering digital technology knowledge and skills, injecting new vitality into engineering courses. By utilizing platforms like Rain Classroom and MOOCs, it enhances the effectiveness of classroom teaching in "Computer Networks", explores how digital technology empowers vocational education, integrates elements of ideological and political education, promotes curriculum innovation, and enhances quality, thereby driving reform in integrating digital empowerment into ideological education in courses.

articleTitle: Research on the Coherence of Analytical Courses in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics Major
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper studies the issue of curricular cohesion in analytical courses within the Mathematics and Applied Mathematics program, taking University of Jinan as an example. It analyzes the current status and impact of core courses such as Mathematical Analysis, ODEs, and Functional Analysis. Difficulties and bottlenecks faced by students in course cohesion are identified, and suggestions for improvement are discussed. Furthermore, teaching cases demonstrating the cohesion among these three analytical courses are presented. The study concludes that optimizing course arrangements, strengthening the consolidation of foundational knowledge, and enhancing student learning interest are crucial for improving the effectiveness of course cohesion.

articleTitle: The dilemmas and challenges of academic misconduct in information forensics--A case study to Indian Cryptographer
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Anbuchelian, Sowmya, and Ramesh proposed "Efficient and secure auditing scheme for privacy preserving data storage in cloud" in 2017. Earlier, Thangavel and Varalakshmi also proposed "Improved secure RSA cryptosystem for data confidentiality in cloud" in 2017, which both core algorithms the modified RSA scheme almost 99% similar. In this paper the authors would discuss how recognize who is victim or perpetrator, it is our research purpose. We analyze and check related information such as personal publication history, well-known database DBLP and so on, then manual work without machine learning to get the evidences, is our method. The research result and conclusion draws in final section.

articleTitle: Effective Path of Building an Industry Education Alliance in the Economic Circle - Taking the Economic Circle of the Capital of Shandong Province, China as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the wave of China's vocational education reform, municipal industry-teaching consortiums, as a new engine for the integration of regional economy and education, have shown their unique value in the economic circle of the capital of Shandong Province. This study systematically organizes the essence of the theory and practice of industry-education integration at home and abroad, and then adopts multiple means, such as interviews, questionnaires, and case studies, to meticulously depict the construction and operation mechanism of industry-education consortiums in seven cities of Shandong Province (Jinan, Zibo, Dongying, Tai'an, Binzhou, Dezhou, and Liaocheng). E204 enterprises demonstrated success in energy conservation and emission reduction through a 30% reduction in energy consumption and a 35% reduction in carbon emissions. The study not only provides an operational strategic guide for the construction of industry-teaching consortia in Shandong Province and even in the wider region, but also lays an empirical cornerstone for the modernization and transformation of higher vocational education and effectively promotes the in-depth integration of vocational education and the regional economy.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on the Dimission of College Teachers
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the four stages of college teachers' turnover behavior, the author uses game theory to establish an interactive relationship model between schools and teachers, analyzes various factors that affect college teachers' turnover behavior including: changes in the internal and external environment of colleges and universities and personal preferences of teachers, various guarantee measures for teachers' life and work in colleges and universities, incentive and constraint measures for teachers with turnover tendencies, and external talent market expected returns faced by teachers. And then the author proposes corresponding countermeasures for college teachers' management.

articleTitle: A Novel Enzyme-Mediated Controllably Constructed Hydrogel Based on PDI
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Protein disulfide isomerase (PDI) mainly exists in the endoplasmic reticulum and plays a crucial role in the correct folding of proteins. PDI catalysis can precisely regulate the breaking and formation of disulfide bonds. This paper designed a double network hydrogel based on the PDI enzyme. The cystamine (CBA) with disulfide bonds in the middle and double bonds at both ends were introduced in the dense network of hydrogels. The results show that the molar concentration of CBA significantly influences the mechanical properties of hydrogels. The CBA is a dense cross-linker in double network (DN) hydrogel, the higher the molar concentration of CBA, the higher the density of the cross-linker, and the higher the Young's modulus of DN hydrogels. When the CBA is 100 mM, the hydrogels have the highest toughness. The presence of PDI enzyme also has an important influence on the mechanical properties of DN hydrogels. The disulfide bonds in DN hydrogels can be broken when the force-coupled enzymatic reactions, thereby Young's modulus of the hydrogels can be changed. The research results may provide a new method for the construction of biomaterials.

articleTitle: Resolution-Adaptive Representation Learning via Eliminating Abnormal Features for Cross-Resolution Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Cross-resolution person re-identification(CR-ReID) seeks to overcome the challenge of retrieving and matching specific person images across cameras with varying resolutions. Numerous existing studies utilize established CNNs and ViTs models to resize captured low-resolution (LR) images and align them with high-resolution (HR) image features. However, these methods overlook the potential feature connections between LR and HR images. Consequently, CNNs or ViTs tend to highlight outliers rather than the intended characteristics in LR image attention maps. In this work, we propose the abnormal feature elimination and reconfiguration transformer (ART) network, a novel network architecture, for robust cross-resolution person re-identification tasks. Our proposed method uses a resolution feature discriminator to learn resolution invariant features and outputs feature matrices of images with different resolutions. We utilize output feature matrices to model LR and HR image interactions through cross-resolution landmark agent attention. We aim to mitigate abnormal image features and prioritize the attention on the target person by learning representations from input images of various resolutions. Extensive evaluations on three real-world datasets confirm the excellent results of our approach.

articleTitle: A low-light fundus image enhancement method based on GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Low-light enhancement in natural images has yielded a lot of results, especially in the presence of reference images. Unlike natural image enhancement, fundus image enhancement is more necessary to keep medical information such as fundus blood vessels unchanged in order to ensure subsequent and accurate medical diagnosis. However, direct application of natural image enhancement algorithms to the fundus image may result in the destruction of the fundus structure. And in clinical applications, there is a general lack of paired high and low-quality fundus images, which poses a further challenge to the study of augmentation methods. To address these problems, an efficient low-light fundus image enhancement model called BN-GAN was proposed. A low-light fundus image dataset was first established. Then, in order to solve the unpredictable brightness degradation, we propose the brightness normalization module. Furthermore, an unsupervised low-light fundus image enhancement method by fusing the attention mechanism in CycleGAN was designed. Finally extensive experiments demonstrate the superior effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Learning Motivation on Learning Engagement: The Mediating Effect of Academic Self-Efficacy
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to explore the influencing mechanism of learning motivation on learning engagement and understand the role of academic self-efficacy, this study used the academic self-efficacy scale, learning engagement scale and learning motivation scale to conduct a questionnaire survey on 462 high school students in a certain school. The results show that: Learning motivation has a positive predictive effect on learning engagement; Learning motivation has positive predictive effect on academic self-efficacy; Academic self-efficacy has a positive predictive effect on learning engagement; Academic self-efficacy plays a chain mediating role between learner’ learning motivation and learning engagement.

articleTitle: Overview of the Development of Manufacturing Process Technology for New Energy Vehicle Power Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the increasing global attention to energy and environmental issues, the development of new energy vehicles has become particularly important. As one of the core components of new energy vehicles, the technological progress of power batteries directly affects the progress of the entire industry. This article first reviews the development history of new energy vehicles and their power batteries, with a focus on analyzing the evolution of power battery manufacturing technology and the current state of technology. It also discusses in detail the advantages and limitations of current mainstream battery manufacturing technologies. Finally, this article will explore the main challenges currently faced by the industry and future development trends. This article provides certain reference value for the development of manufacturing technology for new energy vehicle power batteries.

articleTitle: Analysing Relaxation Effects Through Natural Experiences Using Natural Sounds and VR Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, studies have been conducted on virtual reality (VR) relaxation using VR devices to reduce stress. Our previous study suggested that VR relaxation using a virtual world, a 360-degree image, and a 360-degree video could produce comparable relaxation effects. However, in our study, the 360-degree image had no sound. The addition of natural sounds to the image may potentially enhance the relaxation effect. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the impact of incorporating natural sounds into the 360-degree image for relaxation. We employ five evaluation metrics to measure the relaxation effect: electroencephalography (EEG), heart rate, salivary amylase, State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI), and a subjective stress questionnaire. These metrics are used to calculate the relaxation scores. The experimental results revealed a significant difference in relaxation scores derived from the EEG data. It suggests that adding natural sounds to 360-degree images can enhance the relaxation effect of VR relaxation.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Technology Applications and Security Research in Mobile Internet Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The proliferation of technology has given rise to edge computing as a response to the deluge of data flow, enhancing real-time processing capabilities but also introducing new challenges in data security. This article focuses on key aspects of edge computing technology: data protection, security, access control, identity management, and privacy maintenance. It demonstrates how technological advancements are transforming edge nodes into powerful data processors, enriching services, fostering collaboration between devices and central systems, and boosting service efficiency for users. By examining the implementation feasibility, scalability, and broad applicability of recent solutions, it underscores the importance of edge computing in both enhancing processing efficiency and ensuring privacy, highlighting its pivotal role in modern computational architectures.

articleTitle: MolHyper: Hypergraph-enhanced Graph Network for Accurate Molecular Property Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Accurate prediction of molecular properties plays a crucial role in drug discovery, materials science, and elucidating chemical reaction mechanisms. Recently, the latest advances in deep learning have significantly outperformed traditional methods in this task. However, existing graph-based methods still face challenges in handling complex molecular structures, such as distinguishing molecules with similar structures but different functional groups. To address these issues, we propose a graph network with hypergraph properties, denoted as MolHyper, which mitigates the impact of noise and enhances prediction accuracy by capturing internode message passing and higher-order correlations of motifs. Experimental results on eight benchmark datasets from MoleculeNet demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: Construction and practice of diversified curriculum assessment system in the course of introduction to nursing theory under the ideological and political background
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: to explore how to construct a diversified assessment system in the course of introduction to nursing theory under the background of ideological and political, so as to realize the educational goal of cultivating people by virtue. Methods: with 205 nursing undergraduate students as the research object, students are divided randomly into control group and experimental group, control group implement traditional examination methods, experimental adopt group the diversified assessment methods of integrating ideological and political teaching concepts, after finishing the course, compare two groups of students' course scores and teaching evaluation satisfaction. Results: The students in the experimental group were better than the control group in course scores and teaching assessment satisfaction, and the difference was significant, p <0.05. Conclusion: In the teaching process of nursing introduction theory, the diversified assessment system integrating the ideological and political teaching concept of the course can promote the double improvement of nursing students' professional knowledge and ideological and moral quality.

articleTitle: Impact of a blended online and offline teaching model of psychiatric nursing on nursing students' perceptions of psychiatric disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the impact of online and offline blended teaching mode in Psychiatric Nursing on nursing students' cognition of mental illness. Methods: Four classes of 2021 undergraduate nursing major of a medical university were randomly divided into experimental classes and control classes, the control classes were taught by traditional classroom lecture mode, and the experimental classes were constructed Learning Pass online learning platform of Psychiatric Nursing, and were taught by online-offline blended teaching mode. The level of mental illness discrimination, knowledge of mental health and mental health care, and course grades of students in the two groups were compared before and after the course. Results: The differences between students in the experimental classes and the control classes in terms of the level of mental illness discrimination and knowledge of mental health and final course grades at the end of the course were statistically significant (p < 0.05).
