Conclusion: The online-offline blended teaching mode of Psychiatric Nursing based on the Learning Channel platform can effectively improve nursing students' knowledge of mental illness and enhance the learning effect of the course.

articleTitle: Extraction of Feature Information and Noise Reduction Strategies for Web Pages
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the arrival of the information society, everyone can become a producer and disseminator of information, which makes the webpage information resources greatly enriched. The explosive growth of web information also brings new challenges, the influx of massive information makes the acquisition and processing of information more difficult. People often spend a lot of energy to find the target resources that meet their needs in the vast sea of web pages, and there is an urgent need to explore more real-time, dynamic, accurate, personalized target resource positioning and extraction methods to meet the user's personalized needs. In this paper, we propose to construct a web page traversal algorithm to extract target information, and use and tuning algorithms to reduce the noise of the extracted information, so as to achieve high efficiency automated web page information processing.

articleTitle: The effect of Dongshi Qixue combined with Ding Chen Fu Zheng Tang on gastric cancer patients with postoperative gastrointestinal dysfunction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:To explore the effect of Dongshi Qixue combined with Ding Chen Fu Zheng decoction on gastric cancer patients with postoperative gastrointestinal dysfunction. Method: Sixty patients who underwent gastric cancer surgery at Xingtai Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital from August 2017 to August 2019 were randomly divided into a study group and a control group using a random number table method, with 30 cases in each group. The control group received conventional Western medicine treatment, while the study group received treatment with Dongshi Qixue combined with Ding Chen Fu Zheng Tang in addition to the control group. Compare the recovery time of postoperative gastrointestinal function between two groups, as well as the traditional Chinese medicine syndrome score and quality of life score before and after treatment. Result: The first time of anal defecation, defecation time, and the time for bowel sounds to return to normal in the study group were significantly shorter than those in the control group (P<0.05). The traditional Chinese medicine syndrome scores of the two groups of patients were significantly lower than before treatment, while the study group was lower than the control group (P<0.05). The quality of life scores of the two groups of patients were significantly higher than before treatment, and the quality of life scores of the study group were higher than those of the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: The combination of Dongshi Qixue and Ding Chen Fu Zheng decoction can effectively restore postoperative gastrointestinal function of gastric cancer, improve digestive system symptoms, and improve the quality of life of patients, with certain clinical efficacy.

articleTitle: Based on the idea of treating liver cancer with the method of "Warm Tong introduction"
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the prevention and treatment of liver cancer based on the method of "Warm and Tong introduction". Methods: With the idea of "Warm Tong introduction method" and reference to some literatures from CNKI from 2008 to 2021, the research on liver cancer was summarized. The search terms were "traditional Chinese medicine; Warm Tong; Liver cancer. 8 literatures were selected, including 2 doctoral theses and 6 master theses. Results: What was the use of "Warm Tong introduction method" and its basis were summarized. "Warm Tong introduction method" treatment of liver cancer thought, Drug selection by "Warm Tong introduction method". Based on the therapeutic effect of "Warm Tong introduction method" in the treatment of liver cancer, The theory provides an original plan for the prevention and treatment of liver cancer. Conclusion: It is suggested that the method based on "Warm Tong introduction method" is a feasible idea and method for the treatment of liver cancer.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Exercise Recommendation Based on Knowledge Graph and KMAKT Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the booming development of online education, the number of course resources has shown a geometric growth, and the surge in course resources has also brought challenges in management and personalized learning. As an important component of online course resources, question banks can provide students with a large number of practice questions to help them identify and reinforce their knowledge. However, current question bank systems often lack intelligent and personalized push mechanisms. Knowledge tracking is one of the important means to achieve smart education. This article is based on a knowledge graph and uses the knowledge tracking improvement model KMAKT. The TransR graph embedding algorithm is used to represent the course knowledge graph embedding, and the algorithm is used to obtain the degree of student knowledge point mastery. The deep neural network (DNN) attention network is used to determine the influence of precursor knowledge, and the multi-layer neural network is used to obtain the predicted output of exercise answer results. The exercise recommendation system, taking Java Web application development course as an example, has achieved accurate and personalized exercise recommendations. The experimental results have verified the effectiveness and practicality of the system.

articleTitle: A Novel Security Analysis of ISRSAC Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In 2017, Thangavel and Varalakshm proposed an article "Improved secure RSA cryptosystem for data confidentiality in cloud" which modified the RSA algorithm, as the ISRSAC scheme. In 2019, Liu and Hsu pointed out the ISRSAC scheme theoretical defect while r>3, then the α(n) may not be an integer. Liu et al. applied a little brute force attack (LBFA) to break the short key RSA algorithm. Based on Liu et al.'s idea, the authors applied LBFA to break ISRSAC, our research goal and methodology. There are 10 examples to describe the LBFA operation; examples 1 to 4 analyze the RSA algorithm, and examples 5 to 10 analyze the ISRSAC algorithm; these 8 examples provide strong evidence for our research result. The conclusion is drawn in the final section.

articleTitle: Two samples were Mendelian randomized to analyze the association between serum vitamin D and frozen shoulder risk
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Background: In recent years, epidemiological studies have shown that vitamin D is a risk factor for frozen shoulder (FS), but whether there is a causal association between vitamin D and FS remains unknown. Objective: To explore the causal relationship between vitamin D and FS, in order to provide a theoretical basis for clinical prevention and treatment. Methods: We used pooled statistics from genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to assess a causal relationship between serum vitamin D levels (sample size = 417,580, IEU Open GWAS) and FS (sample size = 451,099, IEU Open GWAS). The main MR analysis method is the inverse variance-weighted method (IVW), supplemented by MR-Egger and weighted median. Second, we performed sensitivity analyses to verify the reliability of the results, examined for horizontal pleiotropy, and used a stay-one-assay to determine if there were potentially impactful single nucleotide polymorphisms. Results: The results showed that MR analysis did not reveal a significant causal relationship between serum 25(OH)D level y and FS risk (OR=1.0108, 95%CI: 0.8218-1.2432, P=0.9185). Conclusion: In summary, this study found no clear evidence of a causal relationship between serum vitamin D levels and the risk of FS. We call for larger sample size studies to further uncover potential causal relationships.

articleTitle: Believe or Make Believe of Academic Misconduct in Information Forensics--A Case Study of Two Cryptography Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Charles, Surendran, and SureshKumar proposed "Heart disease data based privacy preservation using enhanced ElGamal and ResNet classifier" in 2022. Earlier, Thangavel and Varalakshmi proposed "Enhanced DNA and ElGamal cryptosystem for secure data storage and retrieval in cloud" in 2018, which both core algorithms the enhanced ElGamal scheme almost 99% similar. Who is victim or perpetrator, let we check the evidences. In this paper the authors would discuss how recognize who is victim or perpetrator, it is our research purpose. We analyze and check related information such as personal publication history, well-known database DBLP and so on, then manual work without machine learning to get the evidences, is our method. The research result and conclusion draw in final section.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on the Talent Training Model of Big Data Technology in the Perspective of New Quality Productivity
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the lens of new productive forces, the societal talent structure has undergone a reconfiguration. This paper seeks to investigate a groundbreaking model for cultivating big data technology professionals that encompasses "job-oriented courses, competitions, and certifications". Using research methods such as literature reviews, surveys, in-depth interviews, and empirical evidence collection, this paper systematically examines the implementation and impact of the 'job course competition certification' model in the field of big data technology. The research results indicate that the model of integrating job positions into the talent training system, linking the training process with competitions, and assessing the effectiveness through certificate acceptance has enhanced the educational outcomes of this major, strengthened the integration of industry and education, and raised the quality of education.

Author Keywords: Professional development through coursework and certification

articleTitle: Research on the Path of Improving the Digital Competency of Counselors in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, digitalization has penetrated into all areas of social life. As an important base for cultivating high-quality skilled talents, the digital competency of the counselor team is particularly important. Digital competency, that is, the ability to use digital technology and information resources to solve problems, is not only the key to improving work efficiency for counselors in vocational colleges, but also an inevitable requirement to adapt to the development of educational informatization. This paper clarifies the connotation of counselors' digital competency, deeply analyzes its development status and practical difficulties, and discusses the improvement path of counselors' digital competency in higher vocational colleges, in order to provide reference for the modernization and development of higher vocational education.

articleTitle: The Practice and Application of Visualized Experiential Teaching of Binary Function Calculus Based on GeoGebra
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: GoeGebra can organically link theoretical teaching with graphic demonstration, perfectly interpreting the mathematical idea of combining numbers and shapes, and presenting abstract mathematical concepts in visual graphics, achieving teaching effects that traditional teaching methods cannot achieve. This article is based on the Geogebra software to draw binary function graphics, compare the gradient direction of surfaces and the normal direction of tangent planes using graphics, and draw the volume graphics of curved top cylinders. These three applications demonstrate the powerful and convenient graphic drawing function of the software. Visual display can cultivate and enhance students' spatial imagination ability, help them understand and apply abstract concepts, further improve their core mathematical literacy, and effectively enhance the classroom teaching effectiveness of higher mathematics.

articleTitle: A Novel Weakness of SM2 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In 2023, Fan et al. proposed an article "Weakness of Enhanced DNA and ElGamal cryptosystem for secure data storage and retrieval in cloud" which it found a leakage by Thangavel and Varlakshmi's scheme. In this paper, the authors would like to use this method to check SM2 algorithm, and claim their viewpoint is correctness. We also demonstrate that this can be unsafe when the XOR operation is used in a special environment. Mathematical proof and experimental proof must be demonstrated in this article, which is our method. The results showed that the SM2 algorithm not safe.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform of Interdisciplinary Courses under the Background of the Construction of New Liberal Arts: Taking "Data Visualization and Communication" as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The construction of new liberal arts requires breaking disciplinary barriers and achieving the interdisciplinary integration of liberal arts majors. The teaching reform of cross-disciplinary courses is imperative. Starting from the overview of the Data Visualization and Communication course, this paper points out the existing problems in the current teaching. It conducts teaching reform research from several aspects such as the concept of curriculum reform, the design of curriculum content, and the reform of teaching models, and elaborates on the innovative features of the reform. Finally, it summarizes the achievements of the curriculum reform and the direction of continuous reform in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform of Algorithm Design and Analysis Course Under the Background of Engineering Education Professional Certification
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to further improve the level of new engineering professional construction and enhance students' practical programming and innovation capabilities, we carried out teaching reform and practice for the algorithm design and analysis course. Under the guidance of output-oriented and student-centered teaching concept, we analyzed the problems existing in the traditional teaching process of the course, and built up a new course teaching model from the aspects of classroom teaching, course content, teacher-student communication, course assessment, computational thinking as well as moral education. Since the implementation of the new teaching model, the students' grades and learning enthusiasm of this course have been greatly improved, and they have won excellent results in many national algorithm competitions.

articleTitle: TranMix: An improved Mixup for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Deep learning is powerful for medical image segmentation; but it still faces the challenge of limited training data. To alleviate the challenge, we propose TranMix, a hybrid approach that combines image grayscale and grometric deformation in the Mixup approch. We demonstrate its effectiveness in medical image segmentation. This approach improves the accuracy of medical image segmentation.

articleTitle: Experience of Project-Based Learning in Engineering Disciplines Integrated with Generative AI Technology : A Case Study of an Interior Design Project
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper has presented a case study in an undergraduate subject of Engineering Design, in which we implement the project-based learning (PBL) pedagogy and, in particular, introduce to students the state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and encourage them to use such technology in their open projects as the assessment of relevant course. We use a typical case study of an interior design project, to demonstrate using the currently most popular AI technology, i.e. Stable Diffusion (SD), in classical engineering design. Working on this interior design project, various AI-based approaches have been implemented via SD, for a number of different interior design tasks. Results show that using SD with the state-of-the-art AI technology can generate expected design proposals very quickly and efficiently. Such project examples, under the PBL framework, whilst integrated with recent AI technology, can greatly motivate students’ learning and their performance.

articleTitle: Observation on the clinical efficacy of Dapagliflozin combined with Qiliqiangxin capsules in the treatment of chronic heart failure
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To observe the clinical efficacy of dapagliflozin combined with Qili Qiangxin capsules in the treatment of chronic heart failure. Method: Sixty patients with heart failure admitted to our hospital from January 2024 to June 2024 were randomly divided into an observation group and a control group, with 30 cases in each group. The control group received conventional anti heart failure treatment, while the observation group received treatment with dapagliflozin combined with Qiliqiangxin capsules on the basis of the control group. Compare the clinical efficacy, evaluation of cardiac function indicators, and incidence of adverse reactions between two groups. Result: The total effective rate of the observation group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05). The LVEF of the two groups of patients was higher than before treatment, and the observation group was higher than the control group (P<0.05). The LVESD and LVEDD of both groups were lower than before treatment, and the observation group was lower than the control group (P<0.05). The total incidence of adverse reactions in the observation group and the control group were 10.0% and 13.33%, respectively, and the difference was not statistically significant (P>0.05). Conclusion: The combination of Dapagliflozin and Qili Qiangxin Capsules can effectively improve the heart function of heart failure patients and enhance treatment effectiveness. The combination of the two does not increase the risk of adverse events and has good safety, which is worthy of clinical promotion and application.

Author Keywords: Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine

articleTitle: Teaching Practice based on Smart Cloud Platform in Operating System Principles and Applications Course Ideology and Politics
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the smart cloud platform, as an emerging educational tool, provides new opportunities for teaching reform. This paper explores the ideological and political education reform practice in the operating system principle and application course based on the smart cloud platform, aiming to improve the teaching quality of the course and the comprehensive quality of students through innovative teaching methods and integrated resources. First, the course design combines the basic principles and practical applications of operating systems, clarifies the goals of course ideological and political education, and strives to integrate ideological and political education into technical education. Secondly, by building a question bank on the smart cloud platform, students are provided with abundant opportunities for computer practice, which improves their hands-on ability and practical operation skills. In addition, through experimental projects, course case analysis, and other channels, the national science and technology strategy and social responsibility are integrated into the teaching content to enhance students' social responsibility and patriotism. Finally, through a diversified evaluation system and student feedback mechanism, the teaching content and methods are continuously improved to achieve continuous optimization of teaching effects. The research in this paper provides new ideas and practical experience for the ideological and political teaching of the operating system course, which is of certain significance to promoting curriculum reform and improving education quality.

articleTitle: Design of a Demonstration System for Vehicular Edge Computing Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of intelligent in-vehicle devices, demands for server computing performance and network transmission speed have significantly increased, while resources in vehicle-edge computing remain limited. This paper presents a demonstration and learning platform for vehicular edge computing scheduling, employing Web3D technology to create a three-tier model of the architecture, vividly illustrating the resource allocation process. Addressing the dynamic complexity of in-vehicle network environments, this study abandons conventional scheduling methods, opting instead for deep learning algorithms to determine data offloading strategies that can adapt to changing conditions. Furthermore, the design incorporates a virtual academy where users can learn about edge computing, deep learning, and related subjects to gain a comprehensive understanding of the demo system.

articleTitle: The medication pattern of Li Diangui in the treatment of chronic atrophic gastritis and gastric precancerous lesions
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To analyze the medication rules of gastric precancerous lesions of chronic atrophic gastritis by data mining method, and to provide new ideas for clinical diagnosis and treatment of gastric precancerous lesions of chronic atrophic gastritis. Methods: All case data were from outpatients with chronic atrophic gastritis with intestinal metaplasia and atypical hyperplasia who were treated by Professor Li Diangui personally in the Inheritance Studio of National old traditional Chinese Medicine Experts in Hebei Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences from January 2023 to December 2024.Excel software was used to establish a database to calculate the four qi, five flavors, channel tropism, high-frequency drugs and drug frequency, and to analyze Professor Li Diangui's medication experience. Results: A total of 118 cases were included, and the high-frequency drugs derived from data mining were golden thread, Sbaical skullcap root, virgate wormwood herb, combined spicebush root, officinal magnolia bark and barbated skullcup herb, which were used with a cold and warm flavor, with more bitter, pungent and sweet tastes, and with the meridians of the spleen, liver and stomach.Conclusion: Professor Li Diangui advocates that the treatment of chronic atrophic gastritis and precancerous lesions should focus on removing turbidity and resolving toxins, soothing the liver and stomach.

articleTitle: Application and Effect Exploration of AI in Virtual English Teaching and Research Section
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate the application and efficacy of AI in the virtual English teaching environment. By comparing the differences between traditional teaching and virtual teaching, we find that AI technology offers brand new possibilities for English learning. In the virtual teaching and research section, students can practice skills such as speaking, listening and reading comprehension by interacting with AI robots to get personalized learning guidance. The results of the study show that the application of AI in the virtual English teaching and research section can improve students' motivation and interest in learning, as well as enhance their language proficiency and self-confidence.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Future Learning Center in University Libraries Empowered by AIGC
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The Future learning center is a new idea for the construction of smart learning spaces in university libraries. By introducing the perspective of AIGC, the article aims to explore the application prospects of artificial intelligence language models in the construction of future learning center in university libraries. The author proposes that university libraries can utilize new artificial intelligence technologies to construct smart learning spaces, improve information service levels, promote the development of innovation platforms, and cultivate users' creative innovation abilities. Meanwhile, libraries should actively respond to the risks and challenges brought about by artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Geography Curriculum Resource Construction Method Based on Knowledge Graph Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The diversified and integrated learning needs make the construction of geography curriculum resources utilization become the focus of curriculum theory, which is the only way for the self-renewal and development of geography teaching. This paper intends to use literature research method, experiment method, combined with geography teaching theory, through the analysis of high school geography curriculum, combined with education knowledge map to generate high school geography knowledge relationship spectrum, and in-depth analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of the geography curriculum resource construction model based on knowledge graph technology. This research puts forward thinking for further developing geography curriculum resource construction in line with teaching objectives under the background of new curriculum reform, explores the effect of geography curriculum resource model based on knowledge graph technology in specific scenarios, optimizes the geography curriculum resource model, and provides more solutions and innovative ideas for geography curriculum resource construction.

articleTitle: Hybrid differential evolution and Cuckoo search algorithm for solving economic dispatch problems
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Economic dispatch (ED) is an important measure for energy conservation and consumption reduction in power systems, and is a typical multi constraint nonlinear optimization problem in mathematics. To address the limitations of traditional ED solving methods, a hybrid differential evolution (DE) and cuckoo search (CS) algorithm (HCS) is proposed. The HCS algorithm integrates the mutation and crossover operations of DE into the CS framework, enhancing population diversity and global search capability. Further refine the mutation parameters and operations to improve search efficiency and avoid premature convergence. Extensive simulations were conducted on three different ED scenarios, including 13, 40, and 15 unit systems, considering valve point effects, prohibited operating zones, and ramp rate limitations. The comparison results show that the HCS algorithm outperforms several recently published optimization techniques in terms of optimization accuracy, achieving a minimum cost of 17963.83 for 13 units and 121414.19 for 40 units. The HCS algorithm also demonstrates excellent convergence speed and stability, reflected in faster convergence curves and lower variance values. The proposed HCS algorithm combines the advantages of DE and CS, effectively solving the ED problem. Compared with other algorithms, it has advantages in optimization accuracy, convergence speed, and robustness.

articleTitle: Research and analysis on the use of informatization resources in basic education in Jiangxi Province based on K-means
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, education informatization has become a key driving force to promote the process of education modernization. Through in-depth analysis of the use of basic education informatization resources in Jiangxi Province, it can provide decision support for the government and education Departments to formulate more scientific and reasonable education informatization policies and promote the balanced development of basic education informatization in Jiangxi Province. This study collects relevant data from three different groups by distributing questionnaires, and conducts K-means cluster analysis by researching data around the above three dimensions. From the clustering results, whether it is from the perspectives of school administrators, teachers, or students to look at the situation of education informatization construction, they all affirm the construction of basic education informatization in the province, and their cognition is gradually adequate, but in terms of geographical distribution, there are significant differences in the popularization of education informatization resources, the budget of construction costs, the use of resources, and the effect of use among schools in different regions and at different levels.

articleTitle: PMC-CNN: Trajectory Prediction Method Fusing Pedestrian Motion Features
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Predicting how pedestrians will move is a valuable and challenging task. It can be applied to various domains, such as crowd evacuation and autonomous driving. However, in practice, scene information and pedestrian interaction make it difficult to accurately predict pedestrian trajectories. Therefore, more effective processing of information affecting pedestrian trajectories is particularly important. Extraction of pedestrian motion features is insufficient in current research in this area. To address this problem, a neural network trajectory prediction method, PMC-CNN, is proposed. This method incorporates pedestrian motion features and stores the heterogeneous information required for prediction within a knowledge graph. Furthermore, it combines this information with the proposed IN-EX pedestrian motion model, resulting in an improvement in prediction accuracy. In addition, this research applies the prediction framework to a crowd evacuation scenario to improve the efficiency of crowd evacuation. This verifies the effectiveness and practicality of our proposed model.

articleTitle: Stereo Matching Algorithm for Improved Acquisition of Disparity Of Tiny Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Deep-learning algorithms have an excellent nonlinear fitting ability. However, tiny objects in images do not approach the general properties of the fit, which causes the algorithms to have problems acquiring disparity for tiny objects. In addition, the results suffer from problems such as disparity inflation and warping variation. To address the shortcomings of deep learning algorithms, we propose an improved deep learning algorithm based on traditional algorithms. First, the algorithm divides the image into segments based on edges. Second, the edge error disparity and disparity expansion is corrected. Third, it finds the wrong disparity in a small segment, and removes it. The adjacent pixels with disparity removed are grouped into clusters. The matching relationship is established by combining the cluster’s gray, gradient, and feature-point information into matching elements. Finally, removal of disparity warping variation and post-processing is performed. The algorithm can effectively correct error disparity, detect the disparity of tiny objects, and can be applied to practical scenarios where tiny objects are detected.

articleTitle: The Practical Logic and Construction of Smart Classroom in Vocational Education in the Information Technology Era
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has revolutionized various fields of society in a short period of time, transforming people's working methods and lifestyles, and fostering unlimited possibilities for future development. The integration of information technology and vocational education has gradually evolved into a brand-new educational model. Based on this, this article elaborates on the evolution and development process of the vocational education model, through a profound analysis of the integration of information technology and education, transforming the traditional teacher-led approach into a student-centered one, encouraging students to shift from passive to active learning, guiding both students and teachers to become seekers of wisdom. Under the backdrop of the information technology era, this article aims to optimize vocational education models and strive to construct efficient smart classrooms for vocational education.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Strategies for GPU Cluster Cloud Rendering Virtual Simulation Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article aims to explore the application of GPU cluster cloud rendering technology in virtual simulation resource construction, and address the challenges it faces. A series of optimization strategies are proposed, including dynamic load balancing strategy, task scheduling algorithm optimization, resource scheduling and optimization techniques, as well as parallel computing and GPU feature utilization. By establishing application scenarios and setting up 5 tasks from small to large scale, experimental evaluations were conducted to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of these optimization strategies in improving GPU cluster cloud rendering performance. The experimental results show that the optimization strategy significantly improves rendering speed, achieves load balancing, and enhances resource utilization. These optimization strategies are of great significance for improving the overall performance and user experience of GPU cluster cloud rendering. And propose exploring new optimization strategies for future research, such as utilizing artificial intelligence and machine learning for dynamic task allocation and load balancing, researching new resource scheduling algorithms to improve resource utilization, and delving into the parallel computing capabilities and high-performance characteristics of GPUs.

articleTitle: A clinical study on the combination of Hebai formula granule wash and minoxidil tincture for external use in the treatment of androgenic alopecia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:To explore the effectiveness of Hebai Formula Granule Lotion combined with Minodil Tincture for external use in the treatment of androgenic alopecia. Method: Sixty patients with androgenic alopecia admitted to our hospital from April 2022 to December 2022 were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with 5% minoxidil tincture, while the treatment group was treated with Hebai formula granule wash in addition to the control group. Compare the clinical efficacy, new hair score, and hair loss score between two groups before and after treatment. Result: The total effective rate of the treatment group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05); After treatment, the scores of new hair and hair loss in both groups significantly decreased, and the treatment group was significantly lower than the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: The combination of Hebai formula granule wash and minoxidil tincture for external use in the treatment of androgenic alopecia can significantly improve clinical efficacy, promote new hair growth, alleviate hair loss in patients, and improve quality of life.

Author Keywords: Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine Treatment

articleTitle: Research on the Establishment of a Practice Teaching System for Vocational Undergraduate Majors in the Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of digitalization, professional practice teaching in vocational undergraduate colleges is confronted with challenges such as an irrational talent cultivation program, a shortage of digital practice teaching resources, and professional practice teaching scenarios unsuitable for real-world application. Based on an analysis of the trend of digital transformation in education, vocational undergraduate colleges and universities should deepen the school-enterprise cooperation mechanism, create a team of "dual teachers" within and outside the school, update and optimize practice teaching resources, refine practice teaching methods and means, and adopt a diversified evaluation system to promote high-quality development of vocational undergraduate practice teaching. This will ensure that talent cultivation better meets societal needs and that training programs can be more effectively adapted to meet those needs.

articleTitle: Research and exploration of the course Photoshop Graphics and Image Processing based on the SISF-TDPT new teaching model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper actively explores an innovative teaching model and puts forward the SISF-TDPT teaching model in order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional "cramming" teaching and single teaching evaluation methods in the course of the "Photoshop Graphics and Image Processing". This teaching model combines the advantages of SPOC In-class Supervised Flipping and Task-Driven Practical Teaching, aiming to address the shortcomings of the basic teaching model in practical application and overcome the pain points of poor learning initiative and weak control of students in traditional classroom teaching. This paper expounds the design concept of the SISF-TDPT teaching model and its specific teaching design before, during and after class. Based on the all-round development of students' professional ability, a multi-dynamic teaching evaluation system is formulated.

articleTitle: Interventional Study on Improving Interpersonal Communication Ability of High School Students in the "Non violent Communication" psychological health course
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To analyze the disparities in the effectiveness of "Nonviolent Communication"(NVC) activity curriculum of psychological health course on interpersonal skills among senior one students in both regular and international class, and to provide empirical evidence for teaching practices aimed at enhancing students' interpersonal capabilities. Methods A total of 206 first-year high school students were chosen from two high schools in Chengdu offered both regular and international class, using the cluster sampling method. Among them, 105 students were allocated to the experimental group, while 101 students comprised the control group. The experimental group underwent eight sessions of "NVC" activity curriculum, each lasting 90 minutes, conducted from November to December 2022. In contrast, the control group participated in eight sessions of other courses delivered by different teachers. Pre-post test surveys were administered in October 2022 and January 2023, respectively, using the Interpersonal Competence Questionnaire for Adolescents (ICQA). Results The results of the repeated measures analysis of variance revealed significant main effects for both pre-post test and group type. Notably, a significant interaction was found between pre-post test and group, as well as among pre-post test and class type. Further analysis of simple effects indicated that, compared to the control group, the experimental group's "NVC" activity curriculum activities significantly enhanced participants' interpersonal communication skills. Additionally, within the experimental group, students in the international class demonstrated a faster improvement in their interpersonal communication skills compared to those in the regular class. Conclusion The "NVC" activity curriculum effectively enhances the interpersonal skills of both regular and international high school students, with a more pronounced impact observed among students in the international class. Schools should implement the "NVC" psychological health course as early as possible to assist Senior One students in smoothly navigating the adaptation period.

articleTitle: Development and Classroom Application Research of Q&A System Based on LangChain + LLMs
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As China emphasizes intelligent education, the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in this field is becoming increasingly widespread. Q&A systems, as one of the key technologies of AI, are gradually being integrated into classroom teaching. The application plays a significant role in improving teaching quality and promoting personalized learning. However, the application process faces several problems, such as insufficient digital literacy, the inapplicability of traditional assessment methods, and the backwardness of educational concepts and methods. Moreover, in the era of information overload, the information provided by intelligent Q&A systems may be inaccurate. To address these problems, this study developed an intelligent Q&A system based on LangChain framework and LLMs. The system creates a web interface using Streamlit, integrates with LLMs, and enables generative Q&A based on the content of PDF documents. In addition, the study further explores the application of the system in classroom teaching, aiming to change teachers' mindset, promote teachers' teaching innovation, enhance students' personalized learning experience, alleviate the problem of digital literacy deficit, and promote equity and change in education. This study not only provides a new teaching aid for educators, but also provides a practical reference for the in-depth development of smart education.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-modal image-text Retrieval Method based on multi-module graph structure
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology and the widespread application of big data, the amount of media data in the real world is showing an explosive growth trend, and a large number of heterogeneous data have emerged in various industries. Because the scale of data is continuously expanding, the semantic correspondence between images and text has become increasingly important. How to efficiently retrieve in the vast amount of image-text data has become a highly concerned issue. There are still two limitations in the existing cross-modal image-text retrieval methods: 1) Different modal data have different distributions and are uneven. 2) Semantics are complex and abstract, and there is still an insurmountable semantic gap between vision and language. In this paper, we have done the following research: A cross-modal retrieval method based on multi-module graph structure is proposed, including visual, word, and phrase graph structure modules. Due to the complexity of data and the interaction between images and text not only in semantic information but also in rich spatial location information, we propose a visual module that combines image features with location features to learn the relationship between semantics and space using GCN. The diversity of text descriptions makes it difficult to learn consistent text feature representations. For this reason, we first use GCN in the word graph structure module to capture the associations between words based on semantic dependency relationships. Then, in the phrase graph structure module, GCN is used to infer the relationships between noun phrases. Finally, a gated fusion layer is used to filter and reduce redundant information interference. This method has performed well on the Mirflickr25K and NUS-WIDE datasets.

articleTitle: The Application and Research of PAD-BOPPPS Blended Teaching Model under the AIGC Perspective in the Course of "2D Animation Production"
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposes the PAD-BOPPPS blended teaching model under the AIGC perspective and applies it to the course of "2D Animation Production". The blended teaching model integrates the PAD Class and BOPPPS teaching models, to effectively overcome the difficulties encountered by each teaching mode in teaching management and evaluation. In the teaching process of the course "2D Animation Production", the enrichment of teaching resources, the customization of personalized learning paths, and the construction of innovative and accurate teaching evaluation system are realized through AIGC technology, so as to effectively improve the teaching quality, meet the diversified learning needs of students, and promote the cultivation of students' innovative thinking and practical ability.

articleTitle: Research on Topic Mining of MOOC Course Reviews Based on the BERTopic Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study uses the BERTopic model to conduct an in-depth analysis of MOOC course reviews, aiming to identify and optimize key curricular features that impact the learning experience. It has been found that despite the rapid development of the MOOC platform in China, there is a disconnect between curricular design and learner’s needs, which affects rates of course completion. The BERTopic model, with its superior semantic understanding, captures and interprets deeper themes in the data more accurately than traditional topic models. In this study, the model was applied to MOOC reviews and successfully identified 50 topics, showing higher topic consistency compared to existing models. Morever, the BERTopic model reveals possible course issues hidden in themes with a low number of comments, suffering data support and practical guidance for MOOC curricular improvement and educational innovation.

articleTitle: Enhancing Handwritten Digit Recognition: A Comparative Study of Basic and Innovative CNN Models Based on the MNIST Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study compares and analyzes the performance of convolutional neural network (CNN) models combined with residual neural networks (ResNet) and an innovative model in the task of handwritten digit recognition. Experiments were conducted using the MNIST dataset to explore the differences between the two models in terms of accuracy, loss rate, and convergence speed. The basic model, which adopts a classic CNN architecture combined with ResNet, demonstrated efficient training performance and high accuracy. Building on this, the innovative model incorporates residual neural networks, dense connection networks, and attention mechanisms, significantly improving training efficiency and generalization ability. Experimental results show that although the final test accuracy of both models is similar, the innovative model converges faster in the early stages of training and has lower validation loss, demonstrating stronger robustness and stability. This study provides valuable references for further enhancing the performance of handwritten digit recognition models.

articleTitle: Headache-assisted Decision-making System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Knowledge graph is essentially a large-scale semantic network that describes real-world concepts, entities, events and the relationships between them in a more comprehensible way. It has the advantages of massive scale, semantic richness, friendly structure and fine quality. Its advantages are in line with the development of information technology, and it is widely used in systems such as intelligent recommendation, assisted decision-making and automatic question and answer, and is also a focus of research in the field of Internet + Medicine. According to epidemiological statistics, the prevalence of primary headache in China is 23.8%, including 10.8% for tension-type headache and 9.3% for migraine. Headache is easy to develop in all age groups and has many causes, which seriously affects people's daily work and life. In order to help headache patients improve their medical experience, record the characteristics of headache attacks in a more professional way, and assist doctors in clinical decision-making, this paper constructs a headache diagnosis knowledge graph by integrating clinical guidelines and knowledge data in the field of headache. In line with the medical needs of headache patients and clinicians, four functional modules have been designed: pre-diagnosis, headache diary, headache information, and assisted decision-making. Ultimately, the headache-assisted decision-making system based on knowledge graph has been successfully implemented, providing doctors and patients with a medical platform with good social value in the field of headache specialties.

articleTitle: Observation on clinical effect of Liangxue Zhituo prescription on androgen alopecia
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective:Observe the clinical efficacy of the Liangxue Zhituo prescription in the treatment of androgenic alopecia. Method: Seventy patients with androgenic alopecia admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Xingtai Medical College from April 2022 to April 2023 were randomly divided into two groups. The control group was treated with 5% minoxidil tincture, while the study group was treated with Liangxue Zhituo prescription in addition to the control group. Analyze the symptom scores of two groups of patients and compare their therapeutic effects. Result: The total effective rate of the research group was significantly higher than that of the control group (P<0.05); The TCM syndrome scores of the two groups of patients after treatment were lower than before treatment, and the difference was statistically significant (P<0.05); Moreover, the TCM syndrome score of the study group after treatment was significantly lower than that of the control group, with a statistically significant difference (P<0.05). Conclusion: The use of the Liangxue Zhituo prescription to treat androgenic alopecia can significantly improve clinical efficacy. The treatment of androgenic alopecia has certain advantages, and there are no significant serious adverse reactions, which is worthy of clinical promotion and application.

articleTitle: The relationship between mathematics reverse quotient and mathematics learning strategies in junior high school students
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As a kind of non-intellectual factor in students' learning process, mathematics reverse quotient plays a very important role in students' mathematics learning. With the proposal of core mathematical literacy for junior high school students and the increasing pressure of junior high school students facing the midterm examination, it is especially important to help students overcome the difficulties in learning mathematics and find a suitable learning method for themselves. Maths Reverse Intelligence is a kind of ability for students to overcome difficulties in learning mathematics, and maths learning strategy is an effective learning method and regulation chosen by students in order to achieve the improvement of their maths learning effect. There are few studies on the relationship between mathematics IQ and mathematics learning strategies. In this paper, based on a survey of 315 students in junior high school of X Middle School in Bin City on mathematics IQ and mathematics learning strategies, the main conclusions drawn from the statistical analysis are: there is no gender difference and grade difference in junior high school students' mathematics IQ; there is gender difference and grade difference in junior high school students' mathematics learning strategies; and there is a significant positive correlation between junior high school students' mathematics IQ and mathematics learning strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Digitally Empowering Vocational Education with the Integration of Labor and Creativity in the Perspective of New Quality Productivity
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to promote the high-quality development of modern vocational education, towards new productive forces and accelerate the digital optimization and upgrading of the education field. Based on the theoretical review and current situation research of vocational labor education and vocational innovation and entrepreneurship education, combined with the new requirements and expectations of "focusing on building a modern vocational education system" and "comprehensively improving the high-quality development ability of educational services", a comprehensive analysis of the value content, practical difficulties and goals of the integration of labor and innovation in vocational colleges' education is proposed. An innovative model of education and teaching reform is proposed, which is based on the dual main body of school enterprise cooperation and the full linkage and collaboration of all staff, education and teaching, skill training, and job internships in three gradients, and the four-dimensional integration of craftsmanship spirit, teaching practice, teacher strength, and mechanism guarantee.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Cost Control in EPC General Contracting Projects Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In today's data-centric engineering management landscape, the EPC general contracting model has emerged as a key player in the global construction sector, owing to its adeptness in resource integration, project duration reduction, and risk mitigation. Nonetheless, with the expansion of project scopes and growing intricacy, general contractors encounter escalating challenges in cost management. Therefore, this study employs big data analysis to probe into the dynamics of EPC general contracting projects, aiming to unearth optimization techniques for cost control spanning design, procurement, construction, and project completion stages. Through case studies, the research showcases the utilization of big data technology for precise cost forecasting, risk evaluation, and process streamlining, culminating in meticulous control over project expenses. The findings underscore that big data-driven cost control strategies not only bolster the efficiency and accuracy of project cost management but also furnish decision-making support to general contractors, enabling them to gain a competitive edge in the fiercely competitive market landscape.

articleTitle: Clinical Study on the Treatment of Insomnia of Phlegm Fire Disturbing Heart Syndrome with Dong’s Qi Point Combined with Huanglian Wendan Decoction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the clinical effect of acupuncture at Dong’s odd point combined with Huanglian Wendan decoction on insomnia of phlegm fire disturbing heart syndrome. Methods: From November 2020 to December 2021, 90 patients with insomnia of phlegm fire disturbance syndrome were selected and diagnosed in our outpatient department. They were randomly divided into the observation group and the control group, with 45 patients in each group. The patients in the control group were treated with Dong’s Qi point acupuncture. The observation group was treated with Huanglian Wendan Decoction plus or minus oral administration on the basis of the control group. The changes of sleep quality, TCM symptoms, neurotransmitters and serum melatonin in the two groups were monitored before and after treatment, and the therapeutic effects and differences between the two groups were analyzed. Results: (1) After treatment, the scores of falling asleep time, sleep time, sleep quality, sleep efficiency, sleep disorder and daytime function in the two groups were significantly lower than those before treatment (P<0.05), and the scores of patients in the observation group were lower than those in the control group (P<0.05); (2) The improvement of TCM symptoms in both groups was improved (P<0.05), and the observation group was significantly better than the control group (P<0.05); (3) After treatment, the levels of neurotransmitter 5-hydroxytryptamine (5-HT) and melatonin (MT) in the two groups were higher than before (P<0.05), and the levels in the observation group were significantly higher than those in the control group (P<0.05); (4) After treatment, the total clinical effective rate of the two groups was 91.11% in the observation group and 75.56% in the control group, with a statistically significant difference (P<0.05). Conclusion: Dong’s odd point acupuncture combined with Huanglian Wendan Decoction has a good clinical effect on insomnia patients with phlegm fire disturbing heart syndrome, and can also improve the symptoms of patients with traditional Chinese medicine and the level of neurotransmitters and hormones in patients.

articleTitle: Application of TPCF Teaching Mode in University Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Today, with the rapid development of information technology, the traditional classroom teaching mode of teachers and students listening can no longer meet the needs of university education. This paper proposes a Task-Peer-Communication-Feedback (TPCF) classroom teaching mode, which takes task-driven as the starting point, peer instruction teaching method as the guide, teacher-student communication, and student-student exchange as the main line, pays attention to the final teaching feedback and adjusts the teaching process at any time according to the input. It has been proved in practice that this teaching mode can effectively improve students' participation rate in the classroom, improve their understanding of knowledge, exercise their communication skills, and cultivate their teamwork and problem-solving skills.

articleTitle: Gamification Design and Implementation of Cybersecurity Virtual Training Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents a gamified virtual cybersecurity training platform, which aims to control the potential risk of cybersecurity training through virtualization technology, increase the interaction of the training process, improve the learning interest, participation and enthusiasm through gamification technology. Based on insight study of the objectives of training program, this paper designs the training contents, writes the training content into a story script, and then carries out the game design, including game tasks, game scenes and characters, game rules and game reward mechanism. Finally, a gamified virtual training platform is realized, through which users can enter the game, finish the customized game tasks and achieve the training objectives.

articleTitle: Design and application of a new type of butterfly wing clamp pressure sensitive tape with patients with nasal feeding
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective To introduce a new type of butterfly wing clamp pressure sensitive tape for gastric tube fixation and observe its clinical application effect. Methods Patients with indwelling gastric tubes in a hospital from September 2023 to December 2023 were randomly selected and divided into a control group and an experimental group with 45 cases in each group. The control group used traditional tape for fixation, while the experimental group used the new type of butterfly wing clamp pressure-sensitive tape. We compared the rate of unplanned extubation, the rate of lesions at the fixation site of the gastric tube, and the subjective comfort and aesthetics reported by patients between the two groups. Results The rate of unplanned extubation in the experimental group was lower than that in the control group (P<0.05). The rate of skin injury in the experimental group was significantly lower than that in the control group (P<0.05). The comfort and aesthetics of the experimental group were significantly higher than those of the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion Compared with the traditional tape, the new type of butterfly wing clamp has improved the stability, aesthetics and air permeability, and can improve the comfort of patients.

articleTitle: Exploring Key Factors Affecting Students' Adaptability in Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, traditional classroom teaching has been obstructed, making online learning the primary choice for education. Students' adaptability to online learning environments significantly affects their learning outcomes and overall quality of education. This study aims to identify the key factors affecting students' adaptability to online learning. We first preprocess the data by creating dummy variables to make the data suitable for subsequent statistical analysis. Secondly, a quartile relation matrix is used to visualize the Pearson relation coefficients between various variables. Then, the R package IsingFit is employed for model fitting, and a psychometric network model is used to visualize the network relationships, resulting in an undirected relation graph. The experimental results indicate that family economic status, home address, online learning equipment, and the usability of the school's student management system are key factors affecting student adaptability. The results highlight the necessity of improving home learning conditions, providing technical support, and optimizing school management to enhance the online learning experience for students.

articleTitle: Observation on the efficacy of Shuangdanmingmu capsules combined with larrupeptide in the treatment of diabetic
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study and explore the efficacy of Shuangdanmingmu capsule combined with larrupeptide in the treatment of diabetic retinopathy. Methods: 120 patients with diabetic retinopathy treated in our hospital from July 2020 to February 2022 were selected for study. They were randomly divided into control group, observation group 1 group and observation group 2 groups, each with 40 cases. The patients were treated routinely. The control group was treated with calcium hydroxybenzene sulfonate dispersible tablets, 1 group was observed to be treated with lirarupeptide + calcium hydroxybenzenesulfonate dispersible tablets, and 2 groups were given lirarupeptide treatment + Shuangdanmingmu capsules. The clinical efficacy, vision level, macular thickness, VEGF, IGF-1, incidence of adverse reactions and other indicators of the three groups were statistically compared. Results: The total efficiency of the observation group was 90.00%, the total efficiency of the observation group was 92.50%, and the total efficiency of the control group was 67.50% (P<0.05). There is no statistical difference in the overall efficiency of Observation Group 1 and Observation Group 2. After treatment, the vision level of the observation group 1 and the observation group 2 group was higher than that of the control group, and the macular thickness was lower than that of the control group (P<0.05). Conclusion: Shuangdanmingmu capsule combined with larrupeptide has a good effect in the treatment of diabetic retinopathy, can improve patients' vision, reduce macular edema, and have

articleTitle: Hot Topics, Dynamics and Trends in female Education Research : bibliometric analysis based on Citespace
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the growing global awareness of gender equality, female education has attracted much more attention worldwide. To comprehensively understand the current status and progress of relevant research on female education within domestic and foreign academic circles, this paper utilizes a collection of female education-related literature published in CSSCI journals, sourced from CNKI, as the research sample. Employing Citespace as a visualization tool, this study generates visual graphs encompassing keyword co-occurrence, keyword clustering, keyword co-occurrence area, and outburst words. But most of the current research focuses on specific regions and cultural backgrounds, neglecting to analyze the differences and commonalities of female education in different cultural backgrounds. In the future, it is necessary to make full use of big data to provide intellectual support for female education and to pay attention to the complexity and diversity of female education in practical application, so as to further promote the development of female education.

articleTitle: Intelligent and Personalized Vocational Education: Applications and Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The objective of this study is to examine the potential of advanced technological solutions for the implementation of intelligent and personalized vocational education. This paper examines the integration of artificial intelligence, big data, and mixed reality technologies within the context of vocational education. The study puts forth a series of concrete implementation strategies and presents a number of case studies to illustrate the practical applications of these strategies. Furthermore, the paper assesses the influence of these technologies on the enhancement of pedagogical quality and the optimization of the student learning experience. The findings suggest that the utilisation of these advanced technologies can markedly enhance the efficacy and personalisation of vocational training programmes.

articleTitle: Exploring Interdisciplinary Integrated Teaching Models for Medical College English : Based on the Dundee Ready Education Environment Measure (DREEM)
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of interdisciplinary integrated teaching models on medical students learning English, using the Dundee Ready Education Environment Measure (DREEM) inventory for assessment. Factor analyses reveal that student engagement and teacher effectiveness significantly influence perceptions of teaching quality. Gender differences in perceptions highlight the need for gender-sensitive strategies. SEM analysis confirms the DREEM instrument's adaptability and supports the effectiveness of our teaching models. Results emphasize fostering supportive, interactive learning environments and adapting teaching strategies to enhance student engagement, satisfaction, and overall educational outcomes. These findings offer valuable insights for improving medical education through interdisciplinary approaches.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Intelligent Financial System Based on AI+ Technology in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The rapid development of new generation technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence has provided strong support for the financial transformation and management innovation in colleges and universities. This paper focuses on the integration and construction of artificial intelligence technology and college financial system, systematically expounds the basic framework and specific connotation of the intelligent financial system based on AI+ technology in colleges and universities, displays the specific application scenarios of RPA, AI and other technologies in college business in detail, and sorts out the many technical challenges faced in the construction of the intelligent financial system.

articleTitle: Exploration of Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching of Java Programming Focusing on Cultivating Innovative Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Traditional "Java Programming" course teaching is often teacher-centered, resulting in students lacking of independent learning and innovative ability. In this study, we attempt to conduct teaching reform from four aspects: constructing course resources, refining teaching content, implementing teaching model, and adopting multiple assessment mechanism, all guided by a student-centered concept. We propose an online and offline hybrid teaching model, focusing on cultivating students’ innovative ability. The teaching process is strategically designed into three stages: pre-class preparation, in-class internalization, and post-class consolidation. Finally, the analysis of assessment data shows significant improvement in students' innovative ability, indicating highly satisfactory teaching outcomes.

articleTitle: Towards Traditional Chinese Medicine Symptom Prediction with Multi-label Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology has driven further exploration and application of the value of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). However, TCM diagnostic methods face challenges in practical application, such as the coexistence of multiple symptoms in patients, which requires diagnostic methods to consider the complexity of these symptoms comprehensively. Multi-label classification algorithms can effectively identify and classify TCM symptoms. Therefore, we constructed a TCM symptom prediction framework based on multi-label learning method. To be specific, we collect TCM data through inspection, smelling, inquiry, and palpation. Next, we perform data preprocessing through feature scaling, label coding, and data partitioning. Then, we learn the specific data representation for each label by incorporating second-order label correlations. Finally, experiments on the two TCM datasets show that the proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and provides a new perspective for TCM research.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Cosmos: a Comprehensive Exploration of Key Factors Shaping Pulsar Candidates Using HTRU2 Dataset Analysis and Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Following the completion of the 500-metre aperture spherical radio telescope (FAST) and the launch of the 19-beam receiver survey project, the number of candidates obtained from pulsar searches has exhibited a notable increase, resulting in a significant expansion in the number of observable celestial objects and astronomical phenomena. It has furnished a substantial corpus of data for astronomical research. However, the vast quantity of pulsar candidate data presents a considerable challenge in identifying genuine candidates, due to the presence of numerous interfering signals. (1) The search for pulsar candidates is a complex and time-consuming process, necessitating the acquisition and analysis of a substantial amount of observational data; (2) The discovery of each new pulsar contributes to our understanding of extreme physical processes in the Universe. It is therefore necessary to search for new pulsar candidates on an ongoing basis. This paper examines the key factors influencing the identification of pulsar candidates, with a view to developing an efficient screening process. The High Time Resolution Universe Survey 2 (HTRU2) dataset from the University of California, Irvine (UCI or UC Irvine) platform was employed for data analysis and the construction of predictive analysis models. These were evaluated using classification metrics, including precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC curves. The latter were constructed using decision trees (DT), random forest (RF) and alpha-investing algorithms. The experimental results demonstrate that the three most critical factors affecting the pulsar candidates are the mean value of the integrated profile (Mean_IP), the excess kurtosis of the integrated profile (Excess_kurtosis_IP), and the skewness of the integrated profile (Skewness_IP).

articleTitle: Research on High School Mathematics Teaching Design under the Background of Ideological and Political Education in Curriculum - Taking Probability and Statistics as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This article primarily explores the instructional design of the probability and statistics section in high school mathematics within the context of Ideological and Political Education in Curriculum (IPEC). Firstly, it clarifies the principles and frameworks that should be followed in the instructional design of IPEC, and summarizes the instructional design strategies for probability and statistics exercise classes. Secondly, adhering to these principles and following the framework order, the article conducts instructional design by excavating the IPEC elements within the probability and statistics section, defining the IPEC objectives, selecting appropriate teaching methods, and exploring corresponding instructional management and evaluation approaches. Lastly, it provides an instructional design example for new lesson delivery in the probability and statistics section. Based on teaching practice, the effectiveness of the practice is verified through post-test questionnaires and student interviews, with the results indicating that integrating IPEC into high school mathematics instructional design helps enhance students' interest in mathematics learning, improve their mathematical literacy and ideological and moral qualities, and promote their comprehensive development. This practice exerts a positive influence on fulfilling the fundamental task of cultivating students with virtue through education, and can provide certain reference and guidance for frontline high school mathematics teachers in designing IPEC-oriented instructional plans.

Author Keywords: Ideological and Political Education in Curriculum

articleTitle: The Effect of College Students' Mindfulness on Subjective Well-being: The Mediating Role of Spirituality
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To study the mechanism by which mindfulness enhances subjective well-being, and the impact of spirituality on both, as well as to assess the mediating role of spirituality between mindfulness and subjective well-being. Methods: A randomized controlled trial of mindfulness-based intervention was conducted among college students. The trial involved pre-tests, post-tests, and follow-up tests conducted after two months. Data analysis and mediation tests by software SPSS 22& PROCESS. Results: Post-intervention measurements in the intervention group were significantly higher than pre-test. The follow-up tests also showed significant enhance. In contrast, the control group showed no significant differences at any of the three time points. The mediating effect of spirituality between mindfulness and subjective well-being was significant, accounting for 61.6% of the total effect. Conclusions: Mindfulness intervention can improve college students’ mindfulness, spirituality, and subjective well-being sustainably. Spirituality is mediator between mindfulness and subjective well-being.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on the correlation between lung cancer and psychology
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To explore the correlation between lung cancer and psychology. Methods: A comprehensive review of relevant literature from CNKI database was conducted, covering the period from 1983 to 2024. The search terms used were "lung cancer" and "psychology". A total of 93 articles were identified, out of which 84 were deemed relevant for this study. These included 5 doctoral theses, 38 master's theses, 40 journal articles and one international conference paper.
