Results: Through the "lung storing the soul" and human spiritual activities; Modern psychological understanding of lung cancer; Lung cancer and Traditional Chinese Medicine psychology related psychological treatment (regulating "Spirit" treatment of lung cancer, "Five viscera and five sounds match" and "Physical and Breathing Exercise" treatment of lung cancer, aural-point sticking combined with Traditional Chinese Medicine emotional release, Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation and treatment as the core of the five nourishing theory, soothing liver and relieving depression, regulating emotions, mindfulness cognitive behavior training). Conclusion: Based on our findings regarding the correlation between lung cancer and psychology, it is recommended that emphasis should not only be placed on tumor treatment but also on psychological interventions. Furthermore, mind-body integrative approaches should be prioritized in managing patients with lung cancer.

articleTitle: A Study of Teaching Reform in Pharmacoeconomics Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Pharmacoeconomics is the study of economic issues related to the use of pharmaceutical resources in the field of medicine and health and how to optimise the allocation and efficiency of pharmaceutical and health resources, and cross-cutting applied disciplines that inform economics for decision-making in medicine and health. This discipline plays an important role in drug research and development, drug pricing, the formulation of medical insurance catalogue, medical insurance payment scope and clinical rational drug use. At the same time, the new social environment doubles the demand for pharmacoeconomic talents. In recent years, major colleges and universities have opened courses on pharmacoeconomics, and the research hotspots revolve around pharmacy education, educational model, programme and so on. As the discipline started late in China, there are mainly problems such as single teaching mode, weak teaching force, and lack of use of modern educational technology. In this paper, by reviewing the literature and combining teaching experience, we put forward countermeasures and suggestions on the historical development, status quo, hotspots, and existing problems of teaching pharmacoeconomics courses.

articleTitle: A Study on the Construction and Practical Application of the Smart Education Data Platform at Guizhou Traffic Technician and Transportation College
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper investigates the digital transformation at Guizhou Traffic Technician and Transportation College, aligned with the 'China Education Modernization 2035' agenda. It introduces a microservices-based data platform aimed at upgrading educational IT systems, enhancing instructional quality, and informing decisions through smarter data use. The approach integrates microservices, cloud, big data, and AI to achieve efficient data handling and analytics, leading to improved management and decision-making processes. The study documents the platform's architecture, security, challenges, and solutions, along with successes like data visualization and automated reporting. Findings emphasize the project's relevance for vocational education's digital transition, pointing out future challenges, including data security and technology updates. The research concludes with key takeaways for institutions undergoing digitalization, underscoring the paramountcy of data security and tech optimization.

articleTitle: Correspondence Learning via Group-wise Motion Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The outlier removal methods are usually based on Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) for capturing context, which neglect the underlying motion information in images. Recently, CNN-based methods have attempted to address this issue by estimating motion fields and have made significant progress. However, CNNs tend to diminish the discontinuities of motion fields, making it difficult for the network to capture multiple motion patterns in complex scenes. Therefore, we propose a Group-wise Motion Enhancement (GME) block that groups motion fields along the channel dimension to learn multiple motion patterns. This enables the network to identify inliers under different motion patterns more accurately. Experiments show that compared with several existing methods, our method achieves advanced performance on the relative pose estimation task.

articleTitle: A Teaching Innovative Model of C++ Based on Outcome-Based Education (OBE) and Integration of ACM Competition and Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at the main problems of the traditional C++ course teaching, in this paper, a C++ teaching innovation model based on the concept of the Outcome-Based Education (OBE) and the integration of the ACM competition and teaching is proposed based on the background of the era of the New Engineering. It takes the problem-solving and the live code as the main teaching line, takes the information technology teaching as the means, promotes the students’ integration of the theory and practice by the ACM/ICPC competition, and organically combines the process assessment and the final assessment, and implements the diversified assessment forms. For theoretical teaching, the authors put forward an innovative model of C++ teaching based on the concept of the OBE and the combination of the ACM competition and teaching. For practical teaching, the authors designed a keyword-oriented OJ system to address the problem of the large differences in the programming ability among the students. For the course assessment, the authors designed a C++ multi-topic intelligent online examination system. The results of more than ten years’ practical teaching show that the innovative model of the C++ teaching based on the OBE concept and the ACM competition has effectively cultivated the students’ computational thinking and significantly improved their programming ability and innovation ability. In the past ten years, our students won many ACM/ICPC prizes. At present, this teaching innovation model has been effectively promoted and applied in three campuses of our university. It has a certain leading and exemplary role in cultivating the top-notch innovative talents in the field of the computer science with the excellent professional programming ability, computational thinking, the national sentiment, the global vision and the all-round development.

articleTitle: Temporal Attention-Based Interactive Dynamic Graph Convolutional Network For Traffic Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Accurate traffic flow prediction is crucial for mitigating road congestion. While previous studies have developed successful models for predicting future traffic flow, most of them lack effective modeling of spatiotemporal dependencies and struggle with capturing multi-scale spatiotemporal dependencies. This paper introduces a novel approach called Temporal Attention-Based Interactive Dynamic Graph Convolutional Network (TAIDGCN) to effectively model the spatiotemporal characteristics of traffic flow. Firstly, a feature augmentation layer enhances the interactivity of temporal features. Secondly, an interactive dynamic graph convolutional network captures spatiotemporal features through interactive learning. A dynamic graph convolutional block is designed to capture changing spatial correlations using a novel dynamic graph generation method. Finally, a specialized temporal attention mechanism is constructed to capture dynamic temporal dependencies, enabling accurate long-term traffic flow prediction by utilizing local context and numerical sequence representation transformation. Experimental results on real traffic datasets demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed model compared to existing approaches

articleTitle: BOPPPS Overview of Teaching Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper summarizes the application and effect of BOPPPS teaching mode in the teaching of information courses. Through the overview and origin, the basic links and specific operations, the purpose of the research is to explore the application effect of the teaching mode. Research methods include a literature review, empirical studies, questionnaires, and case studies. The study found that the BOPPPS model significantly improves students 'independent learning ability and innovative thinking ability, improves the level of classroom participation and interaction, and enhances students' learning motivation and practical operation skills. The conclusion shows that the BOPPPS model is widely applicable and effective, and can respond to the teaching needs of the post-epidemic era. The future development direction includes exploring its application potential in other disciplines, continuously optimizing the online teaching effect and improving the teaching quality combined with modern educational technology.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots and Trends in Academic Buoyancy : A Visual Analysis Using CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Background: Academic buoyancy has emerged as a new concept within the realm of positive psychology in recent years. Objective: This study aims to identify the research hotspots, frontiers, and trends of academic buoyancy to provide references for future studies. Methods: Literature retrieval was conducted on December 31, 2023, using the Web of Science Core Collection (WoSCC) and the China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI) databases. The search covered publications from January 1, 2008, to December 31, 2023. Publication volume, countries, institutions, authors, and keywords were analyzed using CiteSpace 6.2.R6. Results: A total of 207 articles, 133 in English and 74 in Chinese were selected. A considerable quantity of studies has been published within the last five years. Research hotspots in academic buoyancy focused on academic achievement, learning engagement, motivation, academic burnout, and academic resilience. Frontier studies explored areas such as social support, academic burnout, teacher buoyancy, and academic emotions. Conclusion: Academic buoyancy functions as a mediator between traditional therapeutic methods and real-world challenges. It helps to reduce academic adversities, protect academic achievement, and reduce psychological risks. This study proposes a model which shows the influencing factors and outcomes of academic buoyancy. Future research should focus on the positive environmental factors in terms of their impact on academic buoyancy, student well-being, and psychological risk prevention, expanding the conceptual scope of "buoyancy", and increasing buoyancy levels among different groups.

articleTitle: Goods Anomaly Detection Based on Multi-Branch Feature Extraction and Foreground Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, significant advancements have been made in the field of anomaly detection. Expanding anomaly detection tasks to new scenarios has become a development avenue. Anomaly detection for the outer packaging of supermarket goods is a challenging task due to the diversity of goods’ appearances, which results in some detection methods suffering from limited sensitivity to anomalies and inadequate target mining. To address these issues, we propose a novel unsupervised anomaly detection method based on multi-branch feature extraction and foreground cosine structure mining strategy. Firstly, we use anomaly synthesis technique to enhance the model’s perception of anomalies and construct more precise decision boundaries in the feature space. Secondly, a multi-branch feature extractor extracts and integrates multi-level and multi-scale features, providing rich texture and semantic information to improve the model’s adaptability in real-world scenarios. Finally, the foreground cosine loss focuses on target mining while supplementing local structural information, further enhancing the model’s ability to detect subtle anomalies. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, extensive experiments were conducted on the GoodsAD dataset, sampled from supermarket scenarios. Experimental results show that this method achieves significant performance in image-level detection and pixel-level localization.

articleTitle: Prediction of EGFR Gene Mutations in Lung Cancer PET/CT Images Using Tumor Spatial Structure and Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Lung cancer is a highly diverse disease with various pathological types, gene mutations, phenotypes, and metabolic differences, resulting in complex treatment and prognosis. In particular, epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) gene mutations in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) have become a key factor affecting the course of the disease. Although studies have confirmed the effectiveness of EGFR-targeted therapy, there remains a lack of models capable of accurately predicting the status of EGFR gene mutations.A non-invasive prediction approach based on PET/CT images is proposed in this study. By incorporating the uneven distribution of standardized uptake value (SUV), an index of tumor spatial structure heterogeneity is developed to evaluate the heterogeneity of tumor space structure. This index was combined with the texture features of CT images and clinical information, and an ensemble learning method was used to construct a more accurate and reliable multimodal EGFR gene mutation prediction model. The generalization ability and practicality of the model were verified by evaluation indicators such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and calibration curve. The results showed that the model has excellent accuracy and reliability in predicting EGFR gene mutations. In addition, as a non-invasive prediction method, it can reduce patients' discomfort and disease risk and is expected to play an essential role in the field of precision medicine, providing new research directions and decision-making support for personalized treatment of NSCLC.

articleTitle: Research on Multi channel Text Classification Method Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To solve the problem that a single neural network cannot obtain accurate text information, this paper proposes a text classification model based on neural network multi channel. Firstly, this method utilizes an ALBERT pre trained language model to obtain text vector representations, use CNN to obtain local features of the text, use GCN and BiLSTM to obtain global text feature information in both spatial and temporal dimensions, respectively. Then, this method fuse the features obtained from multiple channels. Finally, this method use softmax to calculate the probability of text category. To verify the performance of our method, this study conducted comparative experiments on the THUCNews dataset. The experimental results show that compared with a single feature extraction method, the performance of the multi-channel text classification model proposed in this paper is significantly improved. Compared with other combined feature extraction methods, the method proposed in this paper can extract richer text information. The method proposed in this paper is compared and analyzed with popular text classification models, and outperforms other models in accuracy, recall, and other indicators, further proving the superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Review of Financial Forecasting Based on Machine Learning in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of big data, the massive amount of data generated in the financial field has attracted wide attention from scholars. Utilizing machine learning models to process such data can effectively improve financial decision-making efficiency and enhance the level of risk control in the financial industry. This study takes various machine learning tools as the framework for analysis and summarizes the selection and optimization methods for different machine learning models. The results indicate that each machine learning method has its own strengths and weaknesses. For different application scenarios, a single machine learning method may not meet the predictive requirements. Combining several machine learning models is the mainstream approach among scholars, which can enhance model performance and improve predictive accuracy.

articleTitle: The Improved Retinex Algorithm Based on the HSV Color Space: Achieving Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement and Color Fidelity
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To address the prevalent issues of insufficient brightness, uneven illumination, low contrast, and blurred details in low-light environment images, we have devised a groundbreaking image enhancement technique. This technique ingeniously integrates the HSV color model with the Retinex theory. Initially, we convert the low-light image from the RGB color space to the HSV domain, enabling more precise adjustments to image properties. Subsequently, within the HSV framework, we utilize an advanced iteration of the Retinex algorithm, augmented with adaptive gamma correction and CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) techniques, specifically designed to optimize the luminance channel of the image. This enhancement notably boosts the brightness of low-light images.Further, by employing bilateral filtering and linear stretching techniques, we enhance the saturation component of the image, ensuring vivid colors. As the final stage, we transform the enhanced image back to the RGB color format and apply automated white balancing mechanisms to accurately restore the true hues of objects within the image. Experimental evaluations conclusively show that our algorithm effectively elevates the quality of low-light images, yielding superior visual outcomes.

articleTitle: Metaverse Improves Students’ Vocational Literacy in Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the current era of information technology, vocational colleges face many challenges in improving students’ professional literacy, and the response to the challenges must rely on more than just the traditional educational model and educational means. With the rapid development of information technology, the emerging metaverse concept came into being. It gradually penetrated various industries, providing innovative solutions to academic problems. With the unique immersive, interactive, and sharing features of the metaverse, vocational colleges can more effectively solve the problems encountered by students in improving their vocational literacy and help them better adapt to the development needs of the information age.

articleTitle: Color Preferences Nudge Children's School Lunch Behaviors—Yellow Enhances Mood
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The influence of color on eating behavior has been extensively documented, with considerable attention focused on tableware colors. Although color preference plays a crucial role, previous studies lack comprehensive understanding of specific context and general color preference patterns, as well as in-depth psychological mechanisms. This study undertook a rigorous investigation into the influence of color preference (Experiment 1) on children's school lunch eating behavior (Experiment 2). Experiment 1 employed the paired comparison method to assess the color preference of children aged 6-14 based on 11 basic colors, and selected 6 colors from them for Experiment 2 color guidance. Experiment 2 used an imaginary task of simulated dining to compare the differences in the impact of 6 colors on various aspects of eating behavior, and conducted further tests on the mediating effect of color emotion based on the SOR (Stimulus-Organism-Response) model. The results showed that changing tableware colors could nudge children's school lunch eating behavior. Yellow had a positive impact on emotion, showing the mediating effect of emotion. In conclusion, these findings provided insights into tableware colors for future school lunch interventions, and offered empirical validation for color-context theory.

articleTitle: A Review of Source Code Plagiarism Detection Techniques for Programming Assignments
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Programming assignment source code plagiarism detection is one of the important challenges in intelligent education. This paper provides an overview of program detection techniques in this field, reviews the related literature, and describes detection methods used over the past five years in terms of source code similarity and changes in coding behavioral features, based on the data and analysis direction relied upon for detection. Finally, it analyzes existing problems and challenges in the field and outlines future research directions.

articleTitle: Data-driven Temporal Evolution Pattern Mining of Blood Glucose for Type 1 Diabetes —— A Comparison Study
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The temporal evolution patterns of blood glucose for Type 1 diabetes patients are often non-stationary and highly nonlinear due to uncertain daily activities. In this work, we first conduct a comprehensive study on different performance aspects of various glucose prediction models, including mixing mechanism-based, transformer-based, recurrent neural network, convolutional kernel-based and other classical models. Moreover, we investigate the model accuracy, the generalization capability and the performance stability of different models. Then a comprehensive performance evaluation and comparison has been carried out based on the OhioT1DM dataset, which comprises various time-varying individual features from 12 patients with Type 1 diabetes over 8 weeks. Compared to other models, the TSMixer model demonstrates outstanding performances in both prediction accuracy and model stability, while the PatchMixer model achieves best generalization ability. The findings of this study provide empirical insights and valuable guidance for adequate personalized prediction models, and further facilitate proactive decisions about diabetes management in response to different lifestyles.

articleTitle: Construction of Personalized Teaching Model for Sports Vocational Colleges Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of educational informatization, various types of schools at all levels are utilizing informatization tools to construct personalized teaching models to improve educational quality and performance. However, cultural courses in sports vocational colleges generally lack personalized teaching, leading to low student interest in learning and reduced teacher satisfaction during lessons. This paper proposes the use of SPSS informatization tools to analyze and statistically process student learning data in sports vocational colleges, and to construct personalized teaching models for cultural courses based on the analysis results. After a semester of implementing personalized teaching practices, students' interest in learning and their academic performance has significantly improved, and teachers' sense of accomplishment in teaching has also increased.

articleTitle: Portfolio Assessment Method: A New Model of Multiple Intelligences Theory in the Evaluation of Undergraduate Teaching Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The article introduces the Portfolio Assessment Method, a novel educational evaluation model grounded in Howard Gardner's Multiple Intelligences Theory (MIT), which posits that intelligence is multifaceted rather than a singular entity. This approach aims to address the limitations of traditional evaluation systems that predominantly rely on written tests, often neglecting diverse intelligences. The Portfolio Assessment Method offers a comprehensive and objective evaluation of students' development across various intelligence domains by analyzing a range of performances and outcomes throughout the learning process. The method has been applied in Western educational practices and is now being explored for undergraduate teaching effectiveness in China. A case study of the medical insurance course at a university in G Province illustrates the practical application of the Portfolio Assessment Method, emphasizing its advantages in promoting holistic student development, enhancing personalized and authentic evaluation, and supporting educational reform. The paper concludes that the Portfolio Assessment Method is a significant tool for educational evaluation within the framework of the MIT, facilitating the comprehensive development of students and the innovation of teaching practices.

articleTitle: Insights from machine learning: modeling the clinical care of hemorrhagic brain pawns
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing incidence of stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, as a serious neurological emergency, prompt and accurate diagnosis and treatment can significantly reduce mortality and disability rates among patients. Clinical decision support plays a crucial role in the research of hemorrhagic stroke. It integrates radiological features, clinical patient information, treatment protocols, and clinical outcomes to achieve precise and personalized efficacy assessment and prognosis prediction. Assisting clinicians in rapid diagnosis and predicting disease progression allows for timely intervention strategies. Predicting hematoma expansion (HE) and selecting appropriate clinical treatment plans are pivotal in managing hemorrhagic stroke. This study processed data extensively to derive model data directly applicable to exploring risk factors associated with HE. The modified Rankin Scale (mRS) was used to assess the prognosis of hemorrhagic stroke patients. Five machine learning models— Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, LGBoost, and AdaBoost—were employed to predict the probability of HE and the prognosis of hemorrhagic stroke patients. Models were further optimized using grid search and ten-fold cross-validation to obtain more accurate predictions. The study identified close correlations among various factors, including mRS scores, and histories of diabetes, coronary heart disease, hematoma volume, and age. RF and XGBoost demonstrated excellent performance in predicting HE probability, with ROC values of 0.98. LGBoost outperformed other models in predicting the prognosis of hemorrhagic stroke patients.

articleTitle: Research on audio characteristics based on auditory characteristics and instantaneous frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel audio feature extraction method that integrates auditory characteristics and instantaneous frequency, aiming to enhance the representation of audio signals. While traditional Mel-scale Frequency Cepstral Coefficient features partially capture human auditory perception, their filter shape significantly deviates from the actual auditory filters. To address this limitation, we introduce the GammaTone filter in conjunction with equivalent rectangular bandwidth scale and instantaneous frequency, resulting in two new feature sets: GammaTone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients and Instantaneous Frequency GammaTone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients. Experimental results demonstrate that both GammaTone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients and Instantaneous Frequency GammaTone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients exhibit superior capabilities in representing non-speech audio signals.

articleTitle: Monocular Depth Estimation using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Depth estimation is to use an RGB image from single or multiple perspectives to estimate the distance of each pixel in the image relative to the shooting point. Currently, monocular depth estimation has achieved good performance in the field of autonomous driving. Due to its portability of self-supervised monocular depth estimation technology, it is considered to have huge prospects in the field of unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV). But it is difficult for drones to match such good effects of autonomous driving because the motion of the drone is less constrained than the car camera and the images taken from drones have a more complex structure. This paper proposes a self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SS-MDE) model suitable for UAV by improving the accuracy of depth estimation. Recent works tend to choose high-resolution images for depth prediction with the development of GPU computing performance. However, the prediction accuracy does not increase with the increase of the resolution in the input images. This paper analyzes the reason is that inaccurate depth estimation makes bilinear interpolation errors reduce the gap between high-resolution and low-resolution images. Therefore, we refer to the U-Net depth estimation network structure to design a dense skip connection between the encoders and decoders of DepthNet, which makes the decoders better fuse image features to improve the accuracy of depth estimation. We train and test the SS-MED on the MidAir dataset[1], which is a dataset collected on the synthetic trajectory of UAV. The experiment shows that the proposed model not only performs state-of-the-art results on the MidAir but also performs well on the video taken by the real UAV scenes.

articleTitle: Eye State Detection Algorithm Based on Shallow Dual-scale Siamese CNN for manufacturing workshop workers
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Eye State Detection (ESD) is an important means of safety risk detection during the interaction between humans and computers in a workshop setting. The deep network model incurs a significant computational cost, making it unsuitable for deployment on computing devices that have weak computing power. This work created a shallow dual-scale Siamese-based ESD model. First, the shallow dual-scale Siamese network is used to extract eye image features, and the high-dimensional features of the Siamese channels are subjected to feature fusion and principal component analysis. Finally, this network is inputted into the Support Vector Machine(SVM) for training and testing. Experiments on the Open and Close Eyes(OACE) and Human Eyes(HE) public datasets show that the detection speed and detection performance comprehensive indicators of the detection algorithm are better than the other seven deep baseline models, and it has better robustness on color and grayscale images with different light intensities and color depths.

articleTitle: WNet: Multi-Task Artistic Portrait Generation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Artistic portrait usually uses a set of sparse continuous lines to capture a person's unique appearance characteristics based on real people or photos. This paper addresses the issues of strong background noise and the loss of key details of human faces in artistic portraiture, leading to the inability to produce realistic and high quality portraits. A multi-task portrait painting model with hierarchical loss called WNet is proposed based on U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>Net used in salient object detection. This model can generate highly abstract portrait painting that do not depend on the background. Compared to existing popular portrait painting generation methods, the images generated by our method have a better visual effect and retain the key details of the facial features better. The experimental results indicate that the proposed WNet is optimal in terms of PSNR, SSIM and MAE performance. Finally, The software communicating robotic arm can quickly spot-paint the fused art portraits.

articleTitle: Research on the Trend of Teaching Reform in Higher Education Institutions in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In history, institutional mechanisms, scale development, and quality improvement have been the three main threads of teaching reform in Chinese universities, interwoven and advancing. At present, the development of higher education in China is in the context of a new stage, new era, and new pattern. Higher education has entered a new stage of development, especially with the arrival of the digital age represented by artificial intelligence, which has brought tremendous impact and opportunities for teaching reform in universities. Based on this, the reform of university teaching requires innovative development, coordinated development, green development, open development, and shared development. Innovative development focuses on solving the problem of development momentum, coordinated development focuses on solving the problem of imbalanced development, green development focuses on solving the problem of harmony between humans and nature, open development focuses on solving the problem of internal and external linkage in development, and shared development focuses on solving the problem of social fairness and justice.

articleTitle: A Teaching Effect Feedback Platform Combined with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, the rapid development of information technology has promoted the diversification of education methods. Online education, as an important supplement to traditional education and an important means of education reform, has become an integral part of the education and teaching process. However, the long-term development of online education still faces many problems, such as difficulties in grasping students' classroom learning states, poor interaction between teachers and students, and difficulty in ensuring the teaching effect. Thanks to the development of deep learning technology and the availability of large-scale facial expression databases, significant progress has been made in the field of facial expression recognition. In this paper, we propose a teaching platform combined with artificial intelligence. This platform uses CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) to recognize students' classroom behavior, specifically their facial expressions, to analyze their learning states and provide timely feedback on classroom teaching effects. The platform can also read video, use advanced image processing and pattern recognition to find expressions and gestures in the video, and mark them, thereby recognizing students' classroom statuses and monitoring their listening statuses. This platform can also generate student behavior reports and visual statistical charts to help teachers better understand students' learning situations and progress, provide teachers with accurate and real-time teaching feedback, help teachers adjust teaching strategies and methods, and improve teaching quality. Finally, after the preliminary test, it is confirmed that the platform has met the initial design requirements and has high identification accuracy and strong data analysis abilities.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Dynamic Graph Convolutional Probability Sparse Attention Networks For Traffic Flow Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Accurate traffic flow forecasting plays a vital role in the effective management and control of intelligent transportation systems. However, existing forecasting methods face constraints due to insufficient information sharing and a limited understanding of global temporal relationships, impeding a thorough analysis of temporal and spatial features. To address this issue, we propose a novel approach called ST-DGCPSA (Spatio-Temporal Dynamic Graph Probabilistic Sparse Attention Networks) for traffic flow forecasting. This framework serves as a general forecasting solution, effectively extracting the temporal and spatial characteristics of traffic flow. Firstly, a temporal graph convolution block is constructed, treating historical time slots as graph nodes and employing graph convolution to capture flexible global temporal dependencies. Next, a dynamic graph constructor is designed to explore spatial correlations between nodes and dynamic temporal dependencies across different time points, fully extracting dynamic spatio-temporal relationships. Lastly, the spatio-temporal convolution block enhances the model's ability to capture spatial correlations, temporal dependencies, and multi-scale modeling through the probabilistic sparse attention mechanism, leading to improved forecasting accuracy. Experimental results on four real datasets demonstrate the superiority of ST-DGCPSA over existing techniques.

articleTitle: MediaFusion and Network Interactive Education: Research on Platform Construction Methods and Educational Effects
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: MediaFusion refers to the integration and interaction of different media forms and channels in the context of the digital age, which promotes cross-platform content sharing and interaction, and also brings problems such as information overload, content quality control, value-oriented diversity and complexity to Internet education. New challenges have also brought new opportunities, and it is of great theoretical and practical value to scientifically and accurately grasp the connotation requirements of online education in colleges and universities. In view of the problems of poor educational effect in colleges and universities, such as the lack of synergy in the education position, the lack of scientific education mechanism, and the lack of resonance in the education content, this paper proposes to strengthen the guidance of scientific value, unite the joint force of the education position, promote the construction of the network team, establish the education mechanism of all staff, excavate the precise ideological and political content, and enhance the emotional resonance of students. The effectiveness of online education has been enhanced.

articleTitle: Identity-based Cloud Storage Integrity Auditing Scheme that Supports Sensitive Information Hiding and Different Audit Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Data in cloud storage often contains sensitive user information, and its integrity can be verified through integrity auditing. However, many existing auditing schemes that support sensitive information hiding often overlook the fact that files have different values, applying the same auditing frequency to both low-value and high-value files. Since users typically delegate auditing tasks to a third-party auditor (TPA), performing high-frequency audits on low-value files significantly increases the user’s economic costs. This paper proposes an identity-based integrity auditing scheme that supports sensitive information hiding and different auditing frequencies (IDIA-SF). Firstly, users classify files based on their value and shuffle the file indices, allowing the TPA to perform different auditing frequencies for files of different values. Secondly, sensitive information within the data cannot be accessed by users other than the data owner (DO) and the administrator. Thirdly, only users authorized by the administrator can access the data in the cloud. Finally, the security and performance of IDIA-SF are analyzed, and the results show that it has satisfactory security and performance.

articleTitle: Exploration of Personalized Python Teaching in Secondary Vocational Schools Based on ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the field of secondary vocational education, such as the teaching of Python programming, there is the problem that the teaching mode can not meet the individual needs of students. By investigating and analyzing the current learning situation of secondary vocational school students, this study finds that there are some significant problems in the traditional teaching mode, such as students' low interest in learning, low participation in the classroom, the uniformity of the teaching mode, the slow updating of teaching materials, and the lack of practicality. To effectively solve these problems, this study proposes an innovative solution based on the premise of Multiple Intelligence Theory and Constructivism Learning Theory: with the natural language processing capability and personalize interactive function of ChatGPT, it provides flexible, diversified, and real-time learning support for secondary school students to learn Python. This study preliminary verified the significant effectiveness of personalized teaching based on ChatGPT in Python programming teaching in secondary vocational schools. Personalized teaching based on ChatGPT is expected to change Python teaching in secondary vocational education and contribute to cultivating more technical talents with practical ability and innovative spirit.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between short video usage, attention and academic achievement among elementary school students
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Due to their entertainment functions and easy accessibility, short-video have become popular among elementary school students. However, there is limited scientific researches on the relationship between short video usage and attention and academic performance, specially for elementary school students, as well as its underlying mechanisms. This paper aims to provide a basis for managing the use of short videos among elementary school students through empirical research. Using a stratified cluster sampling method ,we selected 1052 elementary school students from two elementary school in Shenzhen, dividing the six grades of elementary school into lower grades, middle grades and upper grades. Then we made a self-administered questionnaire to measure the extent of short video usage and recorded the results of the midterm proficiency test in the first semester and the opening proficiency test in the second semester to measure academic performance, as well as the Attention Test for Adolescents were used to measure the attention span of the students. SPSS29.0 was used for descriptive statistics and correlation analysis of the data, and Mplus8.0 was used to validate the relationship between the variables through path analysis. We found 1) Higher levels of short-video use were associated with lower academic achievement (r=-0.236, p<0.001); 2) Higher levels of short-video use were associated with lower attention scores ( β =-0.092, p<0.001); and 3) Attention partially mediated the effect between short-video use and academic achievement: the short-video-use-to-achievement The percentage of direct effect in the total effect is 85.71%, and the percentage of indirect effect through the mediating factor of attention is 14.29%.

articleTitle: Exposing the Attraction of Data- An Examination and Application of Teaching Data Visualization in Multimedia Learning Mode From Theory to Practice
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, data visualization technology has grown in significance and become an essential core technology in the fields of statistical analysis and decision support. However, the current approaches of teaching the Data Visualization course tend to downplay the significance of theoretical knowledge in favor of developing students' practical skills with various information visualization technologies. When students are faced with complex facts, this teaching style, which prioritizes practice over theory, may result in a lack of deep analytical skills and creative thinking. Meanwhile, in order to reveal the charm of data, the process of transforming data information into visual form can significantly improve the presentation effect of data, and observe and browse the data in an intuitive and interactive way, so that it is easier to find the hidden features, relationships, and patterns in the data, which can provide powerful support for data analysis and decision-making.In order to create a naturally occurring combination of knowledge and application and better prepare students for the difficulties of the big data era, teaching Data Visualization educational programs using a blended learning approach requires maintaining a balance between the two.

Author Keywords: and data visualization Combining theory and practice

articleTitle: Hotspot and development trend of democratic education in China : CiteSpace visualization and analysis based on CNKI data
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the development of science, technology and social economy, the importance of democratic education in modern society has become more and more prominent. This paper takes the data, analysed from democratic education literature published in CNKI journals between 2009 and 2024, as the research sample. Using the Citespace tool to draw the visualization graphs of keyword co-occurrence mapping, keyword clustering, keyword co-occurrence area and outbreak words, so as to make a scientific econometric analysis of the hot spots and development trends of democratic education in China. It can be seen that the researches of democratic education in China have become more and more in-depth. In China, most of the current researches focus on the democratization of educational methods and the content of democratic thought education. However, in modern intelligent era, the research on strengthening the communication of democratic consciousness is still rare. For using big data and information technology analysis to promote the development of democratic education, this study puts forward innovative suggestions and valuable insights in the aspects of educational content, educational mode, and professional development of democratic ideology and culture. Benefiting from these, it is possible to provide new ideas for exploring the modern and innovative democratic education of Chinese style.

articleTitle: Study on the Mixed Teaching Mode of Object-Oriented Programming Courses: Online and Offline Approaches Based on OBE Concept
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Addressing issues such as a lack of learning motivation due to unclear ability cultivation goals and the failure of conceptual and theoretical understanding to guide practical engineering skill training, this paper proposes a hybrid teaching design scheme combining online and offline methods. This proposal is based on the teaching concept of "OBE+ Curriculum Ideology and Politics" and is oriented towards meeting students' graduation engineering ability requirements. By reconstructing course teaching design and optimizing implementation methods, a comprehensive practice is outlined, covering teaching modes, content, implementation, and evaluation. This approach aims to provide a reference for reforming programming language courses within the context of new engineering education.

articleTitle: Exploration of Innovative Ideological and Political Education in Computer Programming Courses under the Background of New Engineering--Taking "C Language Programming" as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the context of the new engineering disciplines, the paper constructs a multi-dimensional course ideological and political education model of "Three-Belief Four-Integration Seven-Dimension Integration" to address the problems of mismatched interests and professional abilities, inconsistent competition and research content, and inconsistent evaluation and actual performance in computer programming courses. This model emphasizes the practicality of ideological and political education, focuses on cultivating students' scientific thinking methods and computer ethics, and is committed to cultivating students' innovative spirit, practical ability, and sense of responsibility, fully reflecting professional characteristics and training objectives.

articleTitle: Dynamic Time Warping and Spatial Attention Optimized Deep BiLSTM Model for Traffic Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Addressing the deficiencies in modeling temporal pattern similarities and deep nonlinear characteristics of traffic flow, we propose an optimized DSA-DBLSTM algorithm. This algorithm integrates an improved Dynamic Time Warping (FastDTW) algorithm and an attention mechanism into a Deep Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (DBLSTM) network, aiming to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of traffic flow prediction. We preprocess taxi GPS trajectory data using a distributed resilient dataset (RDD) and apply Kalman Filtering (KF) to remove noise. Then, we construct the DSA-DBLSTM algorithm, optimizing the DBLSTM neural network by incorporating the FastDTW algorithm and the attention mechanism. Experimental results on real taxi GPS trajectory data demonstrate that, compared with 13 benchmark algorithms including ARIMA, SVR, KNN, SAEs, BP, CNN, GRU, ANN, LSTM, BiLSTM, DBLSTM, DSA-LSTM, and DSA-BiLSTM across multi-scale datasets, the DSA-DBLSTM algorithm exhibits optimal predictive performance.

articleTitle: Research on Empowering Human Resource Management Teaching Reform and Innovation with Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the context of the era empowered by digital technology, new industries, new business forms, and new models have emerged. Various industries are driving change at an unprecedented speed, especially in the field of enterprise human resource management, which is undergoing profound transformation towards digitalization. This transformation not only requires enterprises to have efficient data processing capabilities, but also urgently needs human resource management professionals with digital literacy and skills. However, vocational colleges currently face many challenges in teaching human resource management, which seriously restricts the cultivation of human resource intelligence talents. The human resource management in vocational colleges urgently needs to be reformed and innovated through digital teaching, realizing the deep integration of human resource management education and digital intelligence technology, resolving the contradiction between talent supply and demand in the era of digital intelligence empowerment, and providing strong talent support for the social transformation of industrial digitization and digital industrialization in China.

articleTitle: More children, more blessings? The effect of children on depression symptom in old age
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: China has entered a stage of deep population aging, and it has brought great challenges to the country and society. With the aggravation of aging, the physical and mental health problems of the old adults and the subsequent elderly-care problems have been concerned by all sectors of society. With the development of economy and society and the change of fertility concept, especially in recent years, after the change of the fertility policy, whether the number of children has a protective effect on the mental health of the old adults has been widely concerned by the society. This study using the Chinese health and retirement longitudinal study (CHARLS) data, established instrument variable regression models with an instrument variable chosen according with the Chinese fertility preference, and then deeply analyzed the causal effect of the number of children on the depressive symptoms of the old adults.The results of the study showed that, (1) Chinese people had a common fertility preference for boys; (2) and the fertility preference for boys was quite steady among generations. (3) The Naïve Probit regression indicated that, the number of children could significantly increase depressive symptoms in old age, however, the regression of instrumental variable showed that the number of children had no significant effect on the depressive symptoms in old age.Using CHARLS 2018 data, and also using an instrument variable regression, this study made a series of classification analysis according to the respondents’ factors like age, gender, marital status, places of residence (urban or rural areas), and education levels, and moreover, we used the data of CHARLS 2011 made the stability test, and all the results were consistent. This study illustrated that to improve depressive symptoms in older adults by increasing the number of children only was not feasible, and these conclusions will provide theoretical reference for the management of depression status in the old age and the social care for the old adults in China.

articleTitle: Segmented inspection method for workwear based on human keypoints
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In corporate environments, the automated detection of mixed-and-matched workwear faces significant challenges due to employees' diverse styles and inconsistent wearing habits, leading to high misidentification rates with traditional methods. This study introduces a novel segmented detection algorithm based on human body keypoint estimation technology. Using the YOLO-Pose model, human silhouettes and critical workwear zones are meticulously localized, isolating the upper and lower body regions. A specialized workwear recognition system, developed using deep learning methodologies with the YOLOv8 model, accurately distinguishes between summer and winter workwear, categorizing outcomes into three attire statuses. This advanced algorithm significantly improves the recognition of upper and lower garments, ensuring accurate identification even when garments are mixed and matched, reflecting actual workplace scenarios. The framework enhances the evaluation of employee adherence to dress codes and provides robust data-driven insights for intelligent management strategies and informed decision-making.

articleTitle: Based on the impact of AIGC on the innovative practical capabilities of students in secondary vocational schools
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: AIGC is leading an unprecedented and profound change in the field of education, and its core value is to significantly enhance students' innovative ability. By promoting immersive, independent and autonomous learning models, AIGC is closely aligned with the fundamental purpose of education and breathes new energy into building a solid framework for innovative thinking. It not only provides students with a rich and diversified case base of innovation practice, urging students to sharpen their skills and enhance their independent innovation ability in practice, but also optimizes the information screening and retrieval mechanism to ensure that students' innovation practice can be accurately, efficiently and accurately focused on the key areas of innovation practice in the flood of massive information. Therefore, the remarkable results and potential value of AIGC in cultivating contemporary students' practical and innovative ability are worthy of in-depth exploration and careful consideration by educators and scholars.

articleTitle: An optimal path to quickly reach a specified location calculation method for an underground airport
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of modern national defense, research on route and other model designs is becoming increasingly important. Especially, it is more and more urgent to study the model design of underground airport and the optimal routing algorithm. How to find the optimal path scheme more scientifically and quickly from the combination of numerous methods is the key to the rapid arrival of underground airfields to the designated location. This study establishes a multi-objective model algorithm. The transformation calculation of the optimal path is carried out on the basis of model design, facility location, and data extraction. Through the case simulation operation, the fast selection of the optimal path for the underground airport to reach the specified location is realized effectively.

articleTitle: Deep learning radiomics model related with genomics phenotypes for pathological complete response prediction in locally advanced rectal cancer under neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Background: Developing a treatment strategy after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) based on accurate pathological complete response (pCR) predictions is crucial for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC).Objective: To determine the effectiveness of a radiomics model using diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) and T2-weighted in predicting post-nCRT pCR efficacy after LARC.Methods: This study enrolled 237 LARC patients who had radical surgery under nCRT between February 2020 and August 2023. Tumor tissues from 54 patients were RNA sequenced. Radiomics features from preoperative MRI data were used to develop a model for deep learning via the LASSO algorithm. ROC curves were used to assess the model performance. Following Spearman's correlation, analyses of transcriptomic data were conducted to identify the genes correlated with the DPL features.Results: The DPL model, incorporating 7 features and 5 machine-learning algorithms, was used to create risk assessment models. The RF model excelled in predicting pCR, achieving an AUC of 0.91, accuracy of 0.88, and F1 score of 0.89. Furthermore, catabolic processes and pathways related to immunity were associated with selected DPL features.Conclusion: The modified MRI-based radiomics model shows good predictive efficacy in predicting pCR after nCRT in LARC patients. Additionally, we investigated the genomic phenotypes associated with DPL.

articleTitle: A Pairing-Free Identity-Based Broadcast Proxy Re-Encryption Scheme for the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In cloud computing environments, the data owner typically chooses to encrypt his data before storing it on cloud servers. When multiple users request access to the data owner’s information, the cloud server can utilize broadcast proxy re-encryption technology to convert the data owner’s original ciphertext into new ciphertexts for these users to decrypt. Most existing broadcast proxy re-encryption schemes rely on bilinear pairings and hash-to-point operations, which reduce computational efficiency and are impractical for resource-constrained proxy servers. To address this issue, we propose an identity-based broadcast proxy re-encryption scheme that eliminates these complex operations, thereby reducing computational complexity and implementation costs. This scheme can resist chosen-ciphertext attacks and collusion attacks in the random oracle model(ROM). Analysis results show that the proposed scheme maintains security while achieving high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Railway Data Management Maturity Assessment Model
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Scientifically assessing data management maturity and maximizing the value of data elements have become critical priorities in the modern railway industry. This paper examines the technical characteristics and maturity assessment requirements in the field of intelligent railways. A comprehensive assessment indicator system for railway data management maturity is developed, encompassing 36 capability items across 8 domains. Building on this foundation, a novel maturity assessment model is proposed, integrating the Triangular Fuzzy Number-TOPSIS method. This model utilizes the Best-Worst Method (BWM) for assigning and optimizing indicator weights, constructs a weight matrix based on triangular fuzzy numbers, and applies the Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) to determine the final maturity level by selecting the optimal score. To validate the model, a typical railway company was selected for evaluation, confirming the model's feasibility.

articleTitle: Exploring the Collaborative Education Model of Labor Education and Professional Education in Computer Science under the Background of New Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the background of new engineering, the collaborative education mode of computer professional labor education and professional education has become an important direction of higher education reform. This paper aims to explore how to effectively integrate computer professional labor education and professional education, and build a collaborative education system to meet the new requirements of the new economy and new technology for personnel training. This paper first analyzes the background of the new engineering and its challenges to the cultivation of computer professionals, and points out the shortcomings of the traditional education mode in cultivating high-quality compound talents with strong engineering practice ability and innovation ability. In order to construct the collaborative education mode of computer professional labor education and professional education, this paper puts forward seven strategies: clarifying the goal of collaborative education, constructing the curriculum system of collaborative education, strengthening the construction of teaching staff, increasing the investment of teaching resources, enabling labor education by information technology, encouraging students to participate in diversified discipline competitions, and establishing a scientific evaluation system. Through the implementation of the above strategies, this paper believes that the collaborative education mode of computer professional labor education and professional education can significantly improve the comprehensive quality and employment competitiveness of students, and cultivate more high-quality computer professionals who adapt to the development of new economy and new technology for the industry and society. At the same time, the model also provides a useful reference for the education reform of other majors.

articleTitle: AgileVision Academy: Indoor Drone Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Navigating cluttered indoor environments presents a significant challenge for aerial robots, requiring agility, speed, and a high level of reliability to avoid collisions. This project aims to address this challenge by developing advanced algorithms for lightweight drones, enabling them to reach target location and carrying out delivery efficiently and safely. Utilizing camera data to map and avoid obstacles, we create a system that not only maps and perceives the environment but also navigates its path to the destination. Included in the educational content, this project demonstrates the effectiveness of the technology through practical applications and real-world testing, helping the next generation of engineers accumulate technical experience and broaden their understanding of drone navigation algorithms and applications in system integration. It has a milestone impact on education and development of the drone field.

articleTitle: Research On Accurate Push Mechanisms of University Network Cultural Products Based on User Portrait
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the era of algorithm recommendation, the ideological and moral education, values education, and civic education of college students are facing challenges such as the marginalization of traditional media, information overload, diverse values, and personalization of educational subjects. In this new context, fully exploring the content of online cultural products and leveraging precise push mechanisms to enhance the ideological and moral education and values education of university students has become a critical issue for university educators. This paper proposes a method based on user portrait to optimize the precision push effect of university online cultural products, thereby achieving a new paradigm of high-quality online education. Firstly, a user portrait for university students is constructed, which emphasizes multichannel data collection and adds dimensions such as students' ideological and political attitudes, values, online behaviors, and cultural needs to provide data support for precise push mechanisms. Secondly, it innovates the integration of university online cultural products and explores the effective incorporation of excellent traditional Chinese culture. Finally, a comprehensive research framework is constructed to explore innovative approaches for precise push based on personalized recommendation algorithms.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Forecasting Model Based on Spatio-temporal Probability SparseAdaptive Hybrid Graph Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Traffic flow forecasting is the basis for the dynamic control and application of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), which is of significant practical importance in reducing road congestion. The intricate spatial and temporal connections of traffic flow continue to provide a significant obstacle to accurate traffic flow forecasting. To capture the dynamic spatio-temporal features of traffic flow simultaneously, this paper proposes a novel Spatiotemporal Probability Sparse Adaptive Hybrid Graph Convolution Network (STPASHG) for traffic flow prediction, which is mainly composed of a gated temporal convolution network (Gated TCN), an adaptive hybrid graph convolution module (AHGCM), a spatio-temporal convolution block (ST-Conv block), and a Probability sparse self-attention mechanism (ProbSSAtt block). Among them, Gated TCN utilizes dilated causal convolutional networks at different granularity levels to capture the temporal dependence of traffic flow, and AHGCM utilizes static adaptive graph learning (SAGL), dynamic graph learning (DGL), and spatial gate fusion mechanisms to synchronize and adequately capture dynamic spatiotemporal features. The ProbSSAtt block combines the dynamic temporal and spatial features and promotes the STPASHG model to effectively make medium- and long-term predictions. The experimental results demonstrate that the STPASHG model suggested in this research can successfully extract the dynamic spatio-temporal aspects of the traffic flow and has the best prediction performance compared to the widely used baseline approaches.

articleTitle: Data mining of Chinese medicine for the treatment of angina pectoris in coronary heart disease
publicationTitle: 2024 14th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To enhance the effectiveness of Chinese medicine in treating coronary heart disease, this study analyzes internal compound formulas from literature on Chinese medicine for coronary heart disease and angina pectoris published from 2013 to 2023, and explores the patterns of medication use. METHODS: We conducted a literature search for clinical trials on Chinese medicine for angina pectoris in coronary heart disease, using the China Knowledge Network, Wan Fang Database, and Wipo Journal, covering publications from January 1, 2013, to December 31, 2023. Data from the retrieved literature were extracted and entered into an Excel spreadsheet. Frequency statistics for drugs, their properties, attributes, and efficacy were performed using SPSS 22.0 software, while data analysis was conducted with IBM SPSS Modeler 18.0. Association rule diagrams were generated using Cytoscape 3.8.0. RESULTS: A total of 1,327 articles and 1,465 prescriptions were analyzed, encompassing 324 different traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) flavors. The total frequency of TCM usage was 14,875 times. Among the TCMs utilized, those with sweet and warm properties were predominant. The most commonly attributed meridians were the liver, heart, and spleen, and the primary therapeutic effect aimed at invigorating blood circulation and removing blood stasis. The most frequently prescribed Chinese medicines were Salvia miltiorrhiza and Rhizoma Ligustici (Ligusticum wallichii). CONCLUSION: In clinical practice for treating angina pectoris associated with coronary artery disease, TCMs with sweet and warm properties are predominantly used. Medicines are typically selected from those attributed to the liver, heart, and spleen meridians. The primary therapeutic focus is on activating blood circulation and eliminating blood stasis, with Salvia miltiorrhiza, Rhizoma Ligustici (Ligusticum wallichii), Astragalus membranaceus, and Radix Angelicae Sinensis being the most commonly chosen.
